assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/yr; every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 x years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000), far below the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/yr. Consequences baked into this record: (1) servicing is TIME-driven, not mileage-driven — BMW's Condition Based Service mileage triggers are never reached, so the car gets one annual dealer service regardless of distance; (2) tires and the AGM 12V battery age out rather than wear out, so they are scheduled by calendar (~every 5-6 years for tires); (3) used values are quoted from genuinely low-mileage listings and adjusted upward off mileage-blind comparables, with the adjustment stated in each source string. Tax (牌照稅 NT$11,230/yr + 燃料稅 NT$6,180/yr, both confirmed on the Yahoo Autos trim page) and insurance are EXCLUDED by design and appear nowhere in this record. Not a BEV, so no home-charger installation cost applies. TIRE FITMENT — CORRECTED THIS ROUND: the previous draft asserted a staggered 225/45 R18 front / 255/45 R18 rear fitment and used 'the tires cannot be rotated' as a cost driver. The Yahoo Autos TW spec table lists a single 輪胎尺碼 of 225/45R18 and no rear size; the 255/45 R18 figure came from U-CAR alone and is geometrically implausible (255/45 R18 has a ~27 mm larger rolling diameter than 225/45 R18, and BMW's factory CLAR 18-inch staggered pairs match within a few mm — the real staggered partner for 225/45 R18 is 255/40 R18). The front size 225/45 R18 is confirmed; whether the car is square or staggered at the rear is NOT confirmed. Tire budgets below are therefore sized as 'four 18-inch performance tires at TW dealer/premium-shop rates', which is expensive either way, rather than being justified by an unverified no-rotation claim.

purchase.notes: POWERTRAIN: classified 'gasoline'. The Yahoo Autos TW spec table for the 2026 220i M Sport reads 動力型式 汽油, 引擎型式 渦輪增壓/直列4缸/DOHC/16氣門, 1998cc, 184hp@5000rpm, 30.6kgm@1350rpm, 壓縮比 11, 後輪驅動, 8速手自排, 平均油耗 14.7 km/L, 車重 1490 kg. 48V QUESTION — CORRECTED THIS ROUND: the previous draft asserted positively that this car has NO 48V mild-hybrid system and booked that as 'a genuine positive for later-life maintenance'. That assertion is not supported. Yahoo's 動力型式 field only distinguishes 汽油/柴油/油電混合/電動 and would read 汽油 for a 48V mild hybrid too, so the absence of 48V data on Yahoo is not evidence of absence. www.bmw.com.tw was unreachable from this network on every attempt (independently reproduced this round), so BMW Taiwan's own technical data could not be consulted, and the 2 Series Coupé received a 小改款 (LCI) in this generation — exactly the update in which BMW added 48V starter-generators across much of the B48 range. Whether the TW-spec LCI 220i carries a 48V ISG is therefore UNRESOLVED. This does not change the classification: a 48V mild hybrid is 'gasoline' for this table either way, and a full hybrid it certainly is not. But the maintenance plan no longer books a saving for the ISG's absence; it carries a small contingency for it instead. DISCOUNT (NT$110,000, estimated): BMW Taiwan (總代理 汎德) discounts luxury models mostly as value-in-kind rather than list-price cuts. The 2026-08-11 「BMW仲夏禮遇」 campaign article (verified this round) gives, 全車系, a 晶華酒店集團 three-day/two-night package stated at over NT$30,000 in value plus zero-interest financing, and — on 指定車型 only — ONE of 一年乙式全險, a BMW 原廠保養套裝, or 延長保固. Note the article's per-model sections cover 1系列, 5系列/5系列 Touring, X1, X3 and X6; the 2 Series is not mentioned anywhere in it. The 220i M Sport is the entry car in a very low-volume niche coupe line (only ~32 used 220i Coupé listings nationwide across all model years), which supports a real concession but not a deep one. I model NT$110,000 as the cash-equivalent of the hotel package (~NT$30,000) plus a realistic dealer cash-and-accessory concession (~NT$80,000) on a slow-selling niche coupe. IMPORTANT — NO DOUBLE COUNTING: because the campaign offers the 原廠保養套裝 as an ALTERNATIVE to cash/insurance value on 指定車型, and never names the 2 Series, this record does NOT also assume free factory servicing. The buyer is modelled as taking the cash-equivalent concession here and paying full dealer rates for every service in maintenance below. The previous draft counted both, which understated ten-year cost. ON-ROAD FEES (NT$62,000): 領牌 + 代辦 ~NT$12,000, plus ~NT$50,000 of typical delivery accessories (隔熱紙, 行車紀錄器, 車身鍍膜, 踏墊, 避光墊) scaled to a 212萬 imported car. Tax and insurance deliberately excluded. real_cost = 2,120,000 - 110,000 + 62,000 = 2,072,000.

value_checkpoints.source: 8891 中古車 220i Coupe listing page, re-retrieved and re-verified 2026-08-12: exactly one 1-year-old car nationwide — a 2025款 220i M Sport, 1.1萬公里 (11,000 km), 高雄, 車商 asking NT$1,850,000. ADJUSTMENTS MADE (this is a dealer ASKING price, never copied): that car is a 汎德 BPS (BMW Premium Selection) 原廠認證中古車, which carries a certification premium (factory prep + warranty) of roughly 8-10% over ordinary dealer stock, so ordinary dealer retail is ~NT$1,690,000. Private sale then sits a further ~10% below ordinary dealer retail, ~NT$1,520,000, and I add ~NT$30,000 back for our car's lower mileage (7,000 vs 11,000 km) to reach NT$1,550,000 — a total haircut of 16% off the visible asking price, wider than the standard 8-15% band precisely because of the certification layer. Dealer trade-in set ~13% below private sale. This is a 25% loss of real_cost in year one — the steep German first-year hit, and consistent with the other German cars in this batch (BMW 1/3/4 Series and X3 all land at 71-75% year-one retention), not a Toyota-like curve. CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADED to low this round: the previous draft called this medium, but it rests on a SINGLE nationwide listing that additionally needed a two-step adjustment — that is the definition of a single weak data point.

8891 中古車 220i Coupe page, re-verified 2026-08-12: six listings of 2023款 220i M Sport at 2.8-2.83萬公里 all asking NT$1,550,000, all in 桃園 and mostly BMW 原廠認證中古車 — almost certainly only one or two physical cars re-posted by different sales staff, so I treat this as ~1 data point, not 6. Bracketed against the genuine four-year cluster below (NT$1,280,000-1,420,000 across 新北/桃園/台中). ADJUSTMENTS MADE: de-certifying the BPS asking price gives ordinary dealer retail ~NT$1,480,000; adding back for our lower mileage (21,000 vs 28,000 km) gives ~NT$1,500,000 dealer retail; private sale ~12% below that = NT$1,320,000. Dealer trade-in ~13% below private. Original 2023 list was NT$2,090,000 (verified this round on the Yahoo Autos 2023 model page), so the market is asking 74% of list at three years while a private seller actually realises ~64% of real_cost — exactly the dealer-retail-vs-private gap that makes copying asking prices wrong. Retention sits above the FWD 2 Series Gran Coupé in this batch, which is deliberate: a RWD enthusiast coupe holds better than the FWD saloon-derived body.

Extrapolated one year beyond the oldest current-generation (G42) cars available. Real anchor re-verified on 8891 2026-08-12: distinct 2022款 220i M Sport (4 years old) across three cities — NT$1,420,000 @ 3.65萬公里 (新北), NT$1,298,000 @ 4.4萬公里 (桃園), NT$1,280,000 @ 6萬公里 (台中), NT$1,298,000 @ 6.4萬公里 (台中), and one 電洽 @ 6.3萬公里 (台中) — so ordinary dealer retail averages ~NT$1,330,000 at four years. ADJUSTMENTS MADE: rolling forward one year gives ~NT$1,215,000 dealer retail at five years, plus ~NT$25,000 back for our low mileage (35,000 km vs the 36,500-64,000 km of the comparables) = ~NT$1,240,000 asking; private sale ~12% below = NT$1,090,000. Dealer trade-in ~13% below private. Cross-check: a 4-year private sale off that cluster would be ~NT$1,180,000-1,200,000, and NT$1,090,000 is a sensible one-year step down from it. The G42 only launched in Taiwan in 2022, so no genuine 5-year car exists yet — this is a one-year extrapolation off a solid four-car cluster, not a fabricated figure.

EXTRAPOLATED FROM THE PREDECESSOR GENERATION — no 7-year-old G42 exists (TW launch 2022). Method: took the real 8891 prices of the F22 2 Series Coupé at exactly 7 years old, converted them to a retention ratio of the F22's own original list price, then applied that ratio to this car's real_cost. Data re-verified on 8891 2026-08-12: 2019款 220i M Sport asking NT$768,000 @ 8.5萬公里 (高雄) and NT$759,000 @ 9萬公里 (彰化). The 2019 list price of NT$1,900,000 for the 220i M Sport 領航版 was re-verified this round on the Yahoo Autos 2019 model page, so the pairing is exact. Raw retention = 768,000/1,900,000 = 40.4% of list as a DEALER ASKING price at ~85,000 km. ADJUSTMENTS MADE: our car has 49,000 km, roughly 36,000 km less, worth ~+15% on a 7-year BMW, lifting asking-equivalent to ~NT$880,000; private sale ~12% below = NT$774,000, i.e. 40.7% of the F22's list price. Applying 40.7% to real_cost NT$2,072,000 gives NT$843,000, rounded to NT$840,000. Dealer trade-in ~14% below private (older cars take a wider dealer haircut). Confidence low: this is cross-generation extrapolation, and by year 7 the car is out of warranty so the used market is pricing in repair risk — which is why the curve keeps falling rather than flattening.

EXTRAPOLATED FROM THE PREDECESSOR GENERATION, same method as year 7. Real F22 data re-verified on 8891 2026-08-12 at 10-11 years: 2016款 asking NT$388,000 @ 13萬公里 (桃園); 2016款 220i 自售 (個人賣家) NT$488,000 @ 19萬公里 (新北); 2015款 NT$498,000 @ 9.4萬公里 (新北); 2015款 NT$438,000 @ 15.3萬公里 (新北). The 2016 220i Sport original list of NT$1,790,000 was re-verified this round on the Yahoo Autos 2016 model page, so the 130,000 km car retains 21.7% of list as a dealer asking price. ADJUSTMENTS MADE: our car at 70,000 km is below every comparable — roughly half the mileage of the NT$388,000 car and below even the 94,000 km 2015款 that asks NT$498,000 — so asking-equivalent is set at ~NT$535,000 (29.9% of the F22 list), then private sale ~12% below at ~NT$471,000 = 26.3% retention of the F22's list price. Applying 26.3% to real_cost NT$2,072,000 gives NT$545,000. Dealer trade-in ~16% below private, since dealers discount hardest on decade-old German cars. REVISED DOWN this round from NT$560,000: the low-mileage premium here is the single largest unverified judgement in the curve, and the previous draft's ~+42% premium over the 130,000 km comparable put this car at 27.0% ten-year retention — the highest of any BMW in this batch (1/3/4 Series, X3 and 2 Series Gran Coupé span 21.0-26.0%), which a niche coupe with a known-weak engine family should not be. Trimming the premium to ~+38% lands it at 26.3%, at the top of the cohort rather than outside it. The tail does NOT flatten the way a Lexus would: the same 8891 listings openly advertise 「水路通病.正時鍊條均已更新」 and 「通病都處理鏈條滑板已換」, i.e. the market is explicitly pricing known cooling-system and timing-chain repairs into decade-old cars of this engine family.

maintenance.plan_notes: HONESTY NOTE: unlike the price and used-value figures, these maintenance numbers are MODELLED, not quoted from a price list. No primary Taiwan BMW service-price table could be reached — www.bmw.com.tw was unreachable from this network on every attempt (independently reproduced this round), and Mobile01 (the usual home of owner receipts) returns 403 to non-browser clients, which was not circumvented. Every maintenance checkpoint is therefore marked low confidence. MATERIALLY REVISED THIS ROUND — the previous draft's ten-year total of NT$430,000 was wrong on two counts. (1) It assumed the 「3年/4萬公里 BMW 原廠保養套裝」 was secured free at purchase, making years 1 and 3 cost only NT$5,000 and NT$18,000. The 2026-08-11 「BMW仲夏禮遇」 article was re-read this round: the package is offered only on 指定車型, as ONE choice among 一年乙式全險 / 原廠保養套裝 / 延長保固, and the article's model sections name 1系列, 5系列, X1, X3 and X6 — the 2 Series appears nowhere in it. Worse, the same draft also booked a NT$110,000 cash-equivalent discount, so the concession was counted twice: once as cash off the purchase and again as free servicing. This record now takes the concession as cash in purchase.discounts and pays FULL dealer rates for every service from year one. (2) The result was internally incoherent against its own batch: at NT$430,000 the 2 Series Coupé had the LOWEST ten-year maintenance of any German car in the set — below the smaller, cheaper, front-wheel-drive BMW 1 Series (NT$530,000), below the BMW 3 Series (NT$485,000) and X3 (NT$462,000), and far below its own sibling BMW 2 Series Gran Coupé (NT$592,000), which shares the same B48 engine. A RWD M Sport coupe on 18-inch performance rubber cannot be the cheapest German car in the batch to maintain. The corrected total is NT$502,000 (~NT$50,200/yr), which sits between the 3 Series and the 1 Series — the right neighbourhood for this car. WHAT IS ACTUALLY SOURCED underneath the model: (a) the campaign terms and their model scope, from the dated 2026-08-11 article; (b) the front tire size 225/45 R18, from the Yahoo Autos TW spec table — note the rear size is NOT confirmed and the previous draft's 255/45 R18 has been dropped as implausible, so tire lines are budgeted as four 18-inch performance tires at TW rates rather than justified by a no-rotation claim; (c) real-world evidence of this engine family's known failure points, from 8891 listing copy on F22 cars advertising 「水路通病」 and 「正時鍊條/滑板已換」 as selling points. STRUCTURE: at 7,000 km/yr the car never reaches BMW's Condition Based Service mileage triggers, so servicing is purely TIME-driven — one annual dealer service every year, ten visits over ten years, and consumables replaced by calendar age. Years 1-3 sit inside BMW Taiwan's new-car warranty so they carry scheduled servicing only and no repair spend; the step up after year 3 is the tires and the first out-of-warranty risk items. One cost this record no longer claims to avoid: the 48V starter-generator. Whether the TW-spec LCI 220i has a 48V mild-hybrid system is unresolved (see purchase.notes), so years 7 and 10 carry a modest contingency for it instead of booking its absence as a saving.

Powertrain is the B38 1.5L 3-cylinder TwinPower Turbo (156 hp / 240 Nm, 7-speed Steptronic DCT) with a 48V mild-hybrid starter-generator; a 48V ISG only assists and restarts the engine and cannot move the car on battery alone, so this is classified "gasoline", NOT "hybrid". Vehicle licence tax (牌照稅), fuel tax (燃料稅), all insurance and fuel/energy cost are EXCLUDED by design and appear nowhere in purchase, maintenance or selling_costs. Value figures assume a clean, accident-free, single-owner car with full 汎德 service history — which is what a 7,000 km/yr owner would actually have — and are net of the dealer-retail-to-private-sale adjustment described in each checkpoint.

maintenance.plan_notes: WARRANTY: BMW Taiwan (汎德) includes 3年不限里程原廠保固 as standard. Note the previous version of this record dated that to 1 June 2024 and cited an explicitly AI-generated U-CAR answer page; the real basis is 汎德's long-standing programme, announced effective 1 June and applied to cars delivered from 1 May 2009 onward (https://news.u-car.com.tw/news/article/10646, https://www.auto-online.com.tw/news/15323). So faults are covered to year 3, but SCHEDULED SERVICING IS NOT. PREPAID PACKAGE — TREATED AS UPSIDE, NOT BASE CASE: a 3年／4萬公里原廠保養套裝 is a recurring purchase incentive (BMW 3 Series 50th-anniversary campaign to end-July 2025, a September 2025 range-wide plan, a January 2026 new-year plan), but it is promotional rather than a standard entitlement and is usually bundled with dealer financing (月付9,900元起 / 月付5,900元起). This record therefore assumes the buyer PAYS for scheduled servicing in years 0-3; if the package is negotiated in, roughly NT$30,000-35,000 moves out of the year-1 and year-3 periods and the ten-year total barely changes. TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN: at 7,000 km/yr the buyer reaches only 21,000 km by year 3 and 70,000 km by year 10, so BMW's condition-based service calls for an annual oil service and a two-yearly brake-fluid change long before the mileage counter asks, and tyres and batteries age out rather than wear out. LATER-PERIOD GERMAN RISK ITEMS carried deliberately: the electric water pump and plastic thermostat housing (a documented BMW cooling-system failure pattern in the 60,000-100,000 km band), ignition coils on the three-cylinder, the 48V lithium battery, and a contingency for the 48V starter-generator itself — none of which a Japanese equivalent carries. COST BASIS: 汎德 publishes no itemised service price table. The only hard dealer figure obtained is a Mobile01 owner report of ~NT$5,000-6,000 for a 30,000 km service with no parts replaced at a BMW dealer; I used NT$8,000-9,000 for a full annual oil-and-filter service to reflect oil, filter and the higher labour on later work. Brake and tyre pricing sanity-checked against BMWCCT, an independent BMW parts retailer (https://www.bmwcct.com.tw/shop/category.php?id=59, TEXTAR/Zimmermann/BMW OEM pads NT$2,100-4,500, discs NT$4,700-9,800 parts-only), uplifted for the M Sport brake package, 18-inch hardware and 汎德 dealer labour. Ten-year total ~NT$592,000, roughly 2.5x a comparable Japanese compact — that gap, plus the depreciation, is the real story of this car.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, far below the Taiwan average of ~12,000-15,000 km/year. Every checkpoint uses the 7,000 km/year midpoint: 7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km. At this mileage BMW's Condition Based Service (CBS) clock is time-driven, not distance-driven: the annual and 24-month counters trip long before the ~15,000-25,000 km oil interval, and tyres and brake fluid age out rather than wear out. Used values therefore quote LOW-MILEAGE comparables, which in Taiwan sit above the mileage-blind average for German cars. LOW-MILEAGE PREMIUM - SIZED CONSERVATIVELY AFTER RE-CHECK. The prior draft claimed a ~NT$300,000 premium based on 8891 listings read as 94,000-129,000 km asking NT$1,050,000-1,088,000 against low-mileage cars at ~NT$1,350,000. On re-fetch of the same 8891 index the mileage fields did not reproduce (the same listings returned as 7,000-12,900 km), so those exact mileages are NOT reliable. What DOES reproduce across independent sources is the shape: a 2021 G20 320i M Sport at 64,104 km asks NT$1,268,000 (SUM), a 2021 at 80,000 km asks NT$1,198,000 (8891), a 2020 at 76,603 km is privately offered at NT$1,130,000 (Facebook Marketplace), and FindCar's whole G20 320i band runs NT$1,176,000-1,348,000. A genuine low-mileage premium of roughly NT$100,000-150,000 at 5-7 years is supported; NT$300,000 is not. Years 5, 7 and 10 have been trimmed accordingly. EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: 牌照稅 (NT$11,230/yr for 1,998cc) and 燃料稅 (NT$6,180/yr) per the Yahoo Autos spec page, plus all insurance, fuel, parking and tolls. One structural assumption is stated explicitly because it moves years 7 and 10: the 2026 car is a late-life G20 LCI and the Neue Klasse-based successor is expected around 2027-2028, so a car bought at the END of a generation depreciates faster than the 2019 G20 used as the year-7 comparable, which was bought at the START of one. Years 5-10 are shaded down roughly 5% below what the raw comparables imply.

purchase.notes: POWERTRAIN - PLAIN GASOLINE, NO 48V. Independently confirmed on the Yahoo Autos spec sheet, which was fetched in full and contains no electric-motor, ISG or mild-hybrid entry anywhere in the 320i M Sport powertrain block. KingAutos likewise flags only the M340i xDrive as 油電混合(HEV), attributing an 11hp electric motor to it - that 11hp figure is the signature of a 48V starter-generator, which confirms KingAutos does surface 48V systems when present and did not surface one for the 320i. So the Taiwan 320i is a conventional B48 turbo four, correctly classified 'gasoline', and there is genuinely NO 48V starter-generator to budget for in the 7-10 year window. (Note: this is a case where the classification rule and the hardware agree - even had 48V been fitted, the correct classification would still be 'gasoline', since a mild hybrid cannot move the car on battery alone.) DISCOUNT - NT$120,000 (4.8% off list). The 3 Series is a steady seller for 汎德, not a slow-moving model, so cash off is moderate; the realistic package is roughly NT$60,000-80,000 dealer 折讓 plus NT$40,000-60,000 of accessories and 領牌 absorbed by the dealer. The campaign 3年/4萬公里原廠保養套裝, the 乙式險 year and any 4th-year extended warranty are deliberately NOT counted as cash discount - they are non-cash, and counting them here as well as in the early maintenance periods would double-count. ON-ROAD FEES - NT$65,000 = 新領牌照規費 and 車牌/行照 (~NT$800) + 代辦/交車服務費 (~NT$8,000) + accessories and PDI typical at this class (front/rear dashcam, ceramic coating, window film, floor mats, mudguards) ~NT$56,000. Scales with the NT$2,490,000 price point. Tax and insurance are excluded from real_cost by design. Arithmetic check: 2,490,000 - 120,000 + 65,000 = 2,435,000.

value_checkpoints.source: RE-VERIFIED AND UNCHANGED. I re-fetched the 8891 320i index (https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/3-series/320i) independently and the one-year-old anchor reproduced cleanly: a 2025 320i M Sport at 9,000 km asking NT$1,980,000 dealer retail (車商售價) and a second 2025 320i M Sport at 2,379 km asking NT$1,968,000 - the latter was NOT reported in the prior draft but confirms rather than contradicts it. Two listings clustered at NT$1,968,000-1,980,000 make this the best-evidenced checkpoint in the record. Our car at 7,000 km sits between the two comparables. DEALER-RETAIL TO PRIVATE-SALE ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private sale set 12.6% below the NT$1,980,000 dealer retail asking price = NT$1,730,000, within the 8-15% band, because a dealer on a nearly-new German car carries certification, reconditioning and a warranty period in that spread. Dealer trade-in (車商收購價) set a further 13.3% below private = NT$1,500,000. These are NOT listed asking prices. Retention 71.0% of real_cost after one year, i.e. a 29% first-year loss - a German figure, not a Toyota one.

UNCHANGED, BUT ON A WIDER AND PARTLY DIFFERENT EVIDENCE BASE. My own fetch of the 8891 320i index (https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/3-series/320i) surfaced three-year-old comparables the prior draft omitted: a 2023 320i M Sport at NT$1,680,000, a 2023 320i at NT$1,498,000, and 2023 320i Korean parallel-import cars at NT$1,528,000 - the import status matters, as 平行輸入 cars sell below 總代理 cars and should not anchor a 總代理 curve. It also surfaced TWO 2024 320i M Sport listings at NT$1,598,000 and one at NT$1,798,000, which the prior draft did not report; a two-year-old car at NT$1,598,000 caps how high a three-year-old 總代理 car can reasonably be placed. NOTE ON MILEAGES: the mileage fields on this index did not reproduce consistently between fetches, so I anchor on model year and price and treat the quoted kilometre figures as unreliable. Taking the 總代理 M Sport cars only, three-year dealer retail lands at roughly NT$1,550,000-1,600,000; I use NT$1,600,000. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private sale 15% below dealer retail = NT$1,360,000; dealer trade-in a further 13.2% below = NT$1,180,000. Shaded to the bottom of the band because those 2023 cars were early-LCI whereas the 2026 car will be a run-out-generation car by 2029. This is the steep German years-1-to-3 leg: 55.9% of real_cost retained privately at year 3, where a low-mileage Lexus or Toyota equivalent would hold roughly 70%.

LOWERED from NT$1,190,000 / NT$1,020,000. The prior draft set a five-year DEALER RETAIL anchor of NT$1,380,000, which is above the observed ceiling of the entire G20 320i used market. Independent data gathered this session: FindCar's G20 320i band runs NT$1,176,000-1,348,000 across all G20 model years (https://www.findcar.com.tw/q/g20%20bmw%20320i); SUM 汽車網 lists a 2021 320i M Sport G20 總代理 at 64,104 km for NT$1,268,000 dealer retail; 8891 lists a 2021 320i M Sport at 80,000 km for NT$1,198,000 dealer retail; and a 2020 320i M Sport G20 at 76,603 km is offered on Facebook Marketplace at NT$1,130,000 against an original NT$2,290,000 list - a private ask, and note how far below the dealer-retail curve it sits. Our car at 35,000 km carries a genuine low-mileage premium over the 64,000-80,000 km comparables, but that premium is worth roughly NT$60,000-100,000, not the NT$300,000 the prior draft assumed. Five-year dealer retail is therefore set at NT$1,330,000, just under FindCar's observed ceiling. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private 12.8% below dealer retail = NT$1,160,000; trade-in a further 14.2% below = NT$995,000, widened because the car is out of its factory warranty and dealers begin pricing repair risk. Retention 47.6% of real_cost.

LOWERED from NT$1,050,000 / NT$880,000, and the prior draft's headline source claim did not survive re-checking. It cited FindCar as showing a well-equipped 2019 M-Sport averaging NT$1,388,000; my own retrieval of FindCar's G20 320i data returns a band of NT$1,176,000-1,348,000 across four vehicles, so NT$1,388,000 exceeds that source's own observed maximum and cannot be used as a seven-year anchor. Genuine same-generation seven-year data does exist and is used: the 2019 G20 320i M Sport launched in Taiwan at NT$2,290,000 建議售價 (U-CAR articles 48128 and 48781, both read via search snippet - news.u-car.com.tw returns HTTP 403 to direct fetch; a second independent search this session re-confirmed the 229萬 figure). Against real listings, six- and seven-year-old G20 320i M Sport cars at normal mileage transact around NT$1,050,000-1,270,000 dealer retail. Our car at 49,000 km is genuinely low-mileage for its age, so seven-year dealer retail is set at NT$1,160,000, then shaded ~5% for the end-of-generation effect described in assumptions.notes. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private 12.9% below dealer retail = NT$1,010,000 (41.5% of real_cost); trade-in a wide 15.8% below at NT$850,000, because an out-of-warranty seven-year-old BMW is a risk purchase for a dealer. The tail does NOT flatten here the way a Lexus would.

LOWERED from NT$570,000 / NT$445,000. EXTRAPOLATED FROM THE PREDECESSOR GENERATION - no genuine 10-year data exists for the G20, which only launched in Taiwan in late 2019, so real prices for the F30 320i at 10 years old today are used instead. From the 8891 320i index (https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/3-series/320i), 2016-2017 F30 320i cars ask NT$470,000-499,000 dealer retail at high mileage; FindCar (https://www.findcar.com.tw/q/2016%20bmw%20320i%20f30) shows a 2016 F30 320i at 88,986 km for NT$558,000 dealer retail; Carousell shows a 2016 F30 320i at 130,000 km for NT$448,000. A 70,000 km 2016 F30 320i M Sport sedan therefore maps to roughly NT$610,000 dealer retail - genuinely low mileage for a decade-old car, but the premium at this age is small in absolute terms because the whole price band has collapsed. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: private ~10% below dealer retail, then shaded ~5% for the end-of-generation effect and the G20's heavier electronics content, giving NT$550,000 (22.6% of real_cost). Trade-in set 20% below private at NT$440,000 - wider than the usual 10-15% guidance, which is deliberate: a decade-old German sedan is close to a wholesale/auction proposition for a Taiwanese dealer. CAVEAT CARRIED FORWARD AND RE-TESTED: the F30 320i M Sport's original Taiwan list price still could NOT be independently verified. I ran a fresh search specifically for the F30 price and it again collapsed onto the G20 launch article ('大改款3系列新增320i M Sport之選，定價229萬元' describes the 2019 大改款, i.e. the G20). So the F30 denominator remains assumed, not sourced, and this checkpoint stays LOW confidence. The tail keeps falling rather than flattening, which is the correct German shape and is consistent with the maintenance exposure below.

maintenance.plan_notes: SERVICING IS TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN. At 7,000 km/year BMW's Condition Based Service annual counter and the 2-year brake-fluid counter trip long before any distance interval, so this plan bills one dealer visit per year regardless of kilometres, and ages consumables out on the calendar (tyres and the 12V AGM battery at ~5-6 years, not at a wear threshold). MATERIAL CORRECTION versus the prior draft: THE PREPAID SERVICE PACKAGE IS CAMPAIGN-ONLY, NOT STANDARD. The prior draft modelled years 0-3 at NT$3,000 and NT$12,000 on the assumption that the 3年/4萬公里原廠保養套裝 always applies, marked both checkpoints HIGH confidence, and simultaneously listed the package's standard-vs-campaign status as an unresolved open question - an internal contradiction. Searching this specifically resolves it against that assumption: the package appears only in dated, time-limited campaigns (a June 2025 低月付 campaign, a September 2025 '全車系加贈原廠保養套裝，燃油車型享3年/4萬公里保養禮遇' campaign, and a 3 Series 50th-anniversary campaign), with BEVs upgraded to 4年不限里程 in the September wave. It is a promotional gift tied to specific purchase windows, not a permanent entitlement. The related claim that BMW Taiwan gives 3年不限里程 warranty to cars registered from 2024-06-01 also did NOT reproduce - the retrievable material points to a 3年/4萬公里 factory warranty for combustion cars, with unlimited-mileage terms attaching to BEVs. At 7,000 km/year the buyer reaches only ~21,000 km by year 3, so a 40,000 km cap would not bind in practice and the warranty conclusion is unaffected; but the record should not assert an unverified 不限里程 term. Years 1 and 3 are therefore raised to probability-weighted central estimates between the package-applies case (NT$3,000 / NT$12,000) and the no-package case (NT$12,000 / NT$26,000), and both are downgraded from HIGH to MEDIUM confidence. PRICE BASIS - now anchored on a real owner receipt rather than a range: a 2020 G20 320i M Sport owner reports NT$10,222 including tax for a scheduled annual/11,000 km service at an authorised dealer, and a separate G20 320i thread references a 三萬六 (NT$36,000) service invoice for heavier work. That validates NT$11,000-12,000 per annual visit post-package at dealer rates; an independent specialist would be roughly 40% cheaper but is not assumed. NO 48V SYSTEM - the 320i is a conventional B48 turbo four with no 48V starter-generator (verified on the Yahoo Autos spec sheet, which has no ISG entry, and on KingAutos, which flags only the M340i as HEV), so unlike the mild-hybrid cars in this batch there is no ISG/48V battery replacement risk in the 7-10 year window. That is a real, verified saving, not an omission. YEARS 5-7 REBALANCED: the prior draft billed NT$88,000 for years 5-7 against NT$105,000 for years 3-5, i.e. maintenance FELL as the car aged out of warranty, which is the wrong shape. assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, roughly half the Taiwan average (~12,000-15,000). All checkpoints use assumed_km = 7000 * years (7000 / 21000 / 35000 / 49000 / 70000). Two consequences run through the record. (1) Resale: every used comparable used here is a genuinely low-mileage listing read off 8891's 420i Coupe inventory page, not a mileage-blind average, and each source string names the listing and the adjustment applied. (2) Maintenance: at 7,000 km/yr the BMW Condition Based Service clock is driven by TIME, not distance - the annual oil service, the 2-year brake fluid change, filters, coolant, the 12V battery and tyre age-out all land on the calendar long before any mileage trigger. The included 3-year/40,000 km BMW Taiwan service package is therefore never mileage-capped for this buyer: 3 years only reaches 21,000 km. Conversely low mileage does NOT protect the later years - rubber, coolant, battery and the B48 water-pump/thermostat/gasket cluster are age-driven and arrive on schedule. Tax and insurance are excluded by design. Fuel and parking are not modelled.

purchase.source: LIST PRICE CONFIRMED, NO CHANGE. NT$2,690,000 verified this round independently of the prior researcher: BMW Taiwan's own launch release states '420i Coupé M Racing Edition 建議售價：269萬元' and '430i Coupé M Racing Edition 建議售價：322萬元', corroborated by UpToGo ('BMW 4-Series Coupe 420i M Racing Edition：新台幣 269 萬元起'), CARLINK ('269萬元起、新年式BMW 4系列全車系鋒格升級') and TVBS/ETtoday ('全車系建議售價自269萬元起'). Deviation from the researcher's figure is 0%, so the price stands. DISCOUNT RAISED, 110,000 -> 160,000 (5.9%). The researcher's 110,000 (4.1%) is implausibly low for BMW Taiwan: the audited BMW X3 record in this same batch documents a real PTT 菜單 of ~12% off list on a 2,490,000 car, and BMW is the heaviest discounter of the German three in Taiwan. I did not raise it to X3 levels because the evidence genuinely differs in two ways: the 4 Series Coupé is a low-volume halo body style rather than a volume SUV fighting GLC/Q5 on price, and the M Racing Edition is a pre-bundled value edition. My searches for current BMW Taiwan promotions returned incentives delivered as 0% financing over 48 months (up to 1,800,000), 一年乙式全險 and a hotel package rather than headline cash, which is consistent with narrower cash room but not with 4%. 160,000 is a judgement anchored between the two, and is flagged in open questions as unverified.
purchase.notes: Full model name is '420i M Racing Edition (Coupé)'; trim shortened to '420i M Racing Ed. Coupé' (23 chars) for the display limit. POWERTRAIN: 'gasoline' is correct. The 420i runs the B48 2.0L turbo four. The prior researcher asserted the Taiwan 420i has NO 48V system at all (only the M440i) and used that to strike the 48V starter-generator out of the later maintenance windows; I could NOT independently confirm that claim this round, so I have not relied on it. The classification is unaffected either way - a 48V mild hybrid cannot move the car on electricity alone and is 'gasoline' under this table's rules - but the maintenance plan no longer claims the 48V risk item is absent, and the year 7-10 electrical provision is worded to absorb a starter-generator if one is fitted. M Racing Edition content over base M Sport: adaptive LED headlights, laser taillights, M Sport advanced package, red M brake calipers, smoked headlight treatment, gloss-black window frames and rear spoiler. ON-ROAD FEES 65,000 = 領牌 + 代辦 ~15,000 plus ~50,000 of delivery accessories at this class (隔熱紙, 行車紀錄器, 腳踏墊, 鍍膜). This is at the top of the plausible band and roughly double the 35,000 carried by the X3 record in this batch on a similarly priced car; a coupé's large glass area and this buyer's likely coating spend justify the gap, but it is the softest number in this block after the discount. Tax and insurance deliberately excluded. real_cost = 2,690,000 - 160,000 + 65,000 = 2,595,000.

value_checkpoints.source: CORRECTED DOWN from the researcher's 1,980,000. I re-read the 8891 inventory page (auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/4-series/420i-coupe) directly on 2026-08-12 and pulled the full 2025 (1-year-old) 420i M Sport Coupé set at this buyer's mileage: 1,530 km @ 2,080,000; 4,000 km @ 2,288,000 (three listings); 6,000 km @ 2,188,000; 11,000 km @ 2,100,000; 15,000 km @ 2,150,000; 15,800 km @ 2,150,000 (plus one 12,000 km at 電洽). Median ask ~2,169,000; interpolating to 7,000 km gives ~2,180,000. ALL of these are 車商售價 (dealer RETAIL asking), never copied into private_sale_price. DENOMINATOR CORRECTED TOO: the researcher guessed the 2025 420i M Sport Coupé list at ~2,540,000; the real figure is 2,610,000 (8891 新車 2025 4-Series Coupe, '售價261萬起'; 2024 was 255萬). So the dealer ask is 83.5% of list, not the 86% claimed. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -12% from dealer retail to private sale = ~1,918,000, taken to 1,900,000 because at year 1 a private seller competes directly against discounted new stock and near-new registered demos. That is 73.2% of real_cost and 70.6% of list - a ~27% first-year loss off list, the classic German year-one hit and nowhere near a Japanese equivalent. Dealer trade-in 1,650,000, a further 13% below private, consistent with dealers buying near 1.65M to re-ask 2.08-2.29M.

CORRECTED DOWN from the researcher's 1,740,000, which sat above what the market anchor supports. Direct read of 8891 on 2026-08-12: the 3-year-old point is a 2023 420i M Sport Coupé at 16,000 km asking 1,920,000 - but the page shows a 1,920,000 / 16,000 km cluster appearing four times across BOTH 2023 and 2024 model years, so this is duplicated inventory, not four independent cars. Evidence is genuinely thin and I have not pretended otherwise. Neighbouring real points bound it: 2024 @ 15,300 km = 2,080,000 (twice) and 2024 @ 15,800 km = 2,150,000 above, 2021 @ 14,000 km = 1,658,000 below. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -2% off the 1,920,000 dealer ask for this buyer's higher 21,000 km = ~1,880,000 dealer retail, then -12% to reach private sale = ~1,654,000, taken to 1,660,000 (64.0% of real_cost). Trade-in a further 13% below. The year 1-3 slope is gentler than year 1 because the steepest German loss is the initial new-to-used gap; it steepens again once the factory cover lapses.

CORRECTED DOWN from the researcher's 1,400,000. Comparable verified by direct read of 8891 on 2026-08-12: 2021 420i M Sport Coupé (G22, same generation as this car) at 14,000 km, dealer retail ask 1,658,000. That car is a freak at 2,800 km/yr, below even this low-mileage buyer, so a -7% mileage adjustment to reach 35,000 km gives ~1,542,000 dealer retail. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -12% from dealer retail to private sale = ~1,357,000, set at 1,360,000 (52.4% of real_cost). Trade-in a further 15% below private - a wider dealer cut than at years 1-3, because year 5 is the first checkpoint fully outside the 3-year factory warranty (4 years if the extension was taken) and the dealer now carries German repair risk on his own floor. CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADED from the researcher's 'medium' to 'low': this rests on ONE usable comparable plus a mileage extrapolation, which is the definition of a single weak data point under this table's rules. The researcher's supporting cross-check (a 2023 430i Gran Coupé at 54,882 km) is a different body style and generation and I could not re-verify it, so I have not leaned on it.

EXTRAPOLATED - no genuine 7-year data exists for this generation and none has been invented. The G22 4 Series launched in Taiwan in 2021, so the oldest real examples are 5 years old. Method as prescribed: take real PREDECESSOR F32 420i Coupé listings, express them as a retention ratio of the F32's own list price, then apply that ratio to this car's real_cost. F32 evidence re-read directly from 8891 on 2026-08-12, WITH TWO OF THE RESEARCHER'S DATES CORRECTED - the two listings they cited as '2018 M Sport' are actually 2017 cars: 2018 420i Coupe (base/標準 trim, not M Sport) at 50,000 km asking 728,000, an almost exact mileage match for this buyer; 2017 420i M Sport at 95,000 km asking 768,000; 2017 420i Sport Line at 90,000 km asking 667,000; 2017 420i M Sport at 120,000 km asking 688,000. The 2017 M Sport vs 2017 Sport Line pair at similar mileage shows an ~15% M Sport premium. Building a 7-year (2019) M Sport at 49,000 km from these gives ~885,000 dealer retail against an F32 420i M Sport list of ~2,300,000 = 38.5%. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: -12% to private sale = 33.9% of list, applied to real_cost 2,595,000 -> 880,000. THE RESEARCHER'S UNSOURCED +5% NUDGE REMOVED: they computed ~900,000 by the same method and then raised it to 950,000 'because the G22 is a more desirable car', which is an opinion, not evidence. maintenance.plan_notes: period_cost is the spend SINCE THE PREVIOUS checkpoint, never cumulative (1 = 0-1y, 3 = 1-3y, 5 = 3-5y, 7 = 5-7y, 10 = 7-10y). Ten-year total ~547,000, materially above a Japanese equivalent and above the 462,000 carried by the BMW X3 record in this batch, which is right for a coupé on staggered 19-inch runflats. THE BIGGEST STRUCTURAL FACT, RE-VERIFIED THIS ROUND: BMW Taiwan (汎德) bundles a 3年／4萬公里原廠保養套裝 (prepaid factory service package) with every new combustion car, alongside a 3-year warranty, with some campaigns adding 原廠第4年延長保固 and 一年乙式全險. At 7,000 km/yr this buyer reaches only 21,000 km in three years, so the 40,000 km cap NEVER binds and the package absorbs essentially all scheduled servicing for years 0-3. That is why years 1 and 3 look almost free. It is a subsidy, not low cost, so the later periods carry the FULL unsubsidised bill with nothing amortised away. INTERVALS ARE TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN: at 7,000 km/yr the Condition Based Service system triggers on the calendar - annual oil service, brake fluid every 2 years, filters, coolant, and age-out of tyres and the 12V battery all arrive long before any distance threshold. Low mileage does not save this car; rubber and chemistry age regardless. THE STEP CHANGE AT YEAR 3-5 IS REAL, NOT AN ARTEFACT: 12,000 for the whole 1-3y window versus 118,000 for 3-5y is the package ending and the consumables cycle landing at once (first tyre set, 12V battery, spark plugs, brake fluid, first unsubsidised services). THE B48 RISK CLUSTER drives years 5-10: the electric water pump, thermostat, oil filter housing gasket and valve cover gasket are the documented failure group on this engine family, and Taiwan specialists recommend doing them together because the pump job alone requires pulling the intake manifold, alternator and A/C compressor. A probability-weighted provision sits at 5-7y and the near-certain full job at 7-10y. ON 48V: the previous version of this record asserted the Taiwan 420i has no 48V system and used that to explicitly zero out the mild-hybrid starter-generator as a risk item. That claim could not be independently confirmed, so this plan no longer makes it - the year 7-10 electrical provision is written to absorb a starter-generator if one is fitted. Costs assume BMW dealer rates for years 0-5 and a dealer / reputable independent BMW specialist mix from year 5 on, which is what most Taiwanese owners actually do post-warranty. Labour and parts anchors come from Mobile01 owner receipts for the closely related G20 320i (same B48 engine, same dealer network): a routine service invoice around 15,000, and a larger work order around 36,000 itemising brake pads at 8,750 and an air filter at 1,300.

maintenance.plan_notes: BMW Taiwan (importer 汎德) gives 3 years' unlimited-mileage warranty as standard. CRITICALLY, that covers REPAIRS ONLY: Taiwan does not bundle free scheduled servicing, which 汎德 sells separately as an optional 保養套餐. So years 0-3 are cheap because failures are someone else's problem, but the owner still pays every 定保 invoice; from year 3 onward the periods carry the FULL unsubsidised cost including repair risk. At 7,000 km/year the interval is TIME-driven, not mileage-driven: BMW's CBS system calls an annual oil service well before the ~10,000-15,000 km trigger, and brake fluid (2 years), coolant, tyres and the 12V AGM battery all age out rather than wear out. Dealer rates come from two Taiwanese cost breakdowns: basic oil+filter service NT$5,000-12,000 (owner work orders quoted at 8,000-9,600 / 8,500-8,700 / 8,500-10,000 for the first three services); brake fluid 2,500-4,500; cabin/air filters 2,000-5,000 each; spark plugs 4,000-10,000; gearbox oil 12,000-25,000; pads per axle 4,000-8,000; discs per axle 8,000-20,000; AGM battery 8,000-15,000 (needs computer registration); tyres 3,500-12,000+ each - this car wears staggered 19-inch rubber, so a set runs ~46,000. A 60,000 km major service is quoted at 20,000-35,000 at a dealer. Later periods deliberately carry German-specific risk items: electric water pump and thermostat, valve-cover gasket oil seepage, coil packs, dampers, and the 48V lithium pack / BSG starter-generator, which has no cheap aftermarket answer. NOT included: air suspension - the 520i M Sport runs conventional M Sport suspension, so an air-strut failure line would be wrong. SOURCING WARNING added during fact-checking: the itemised price table used for the later periods (比迪行銷) carries an explicit disclosure at the foot of the page that the article was written by AI ('本文由AI創作'), and the other source's work orders are from 3 Series / 4 Series / X1 owners, not a 5 Series. Both are plausible and mutually consistent, but neither is a 汎德 price list or a 5 Series invoice, so the years 5 and 7 checkpoints were downgraded to low confidence. That same source benchmarks BMW in-warranty servicing at 6,000-9,500 per visit against 3,000-4,500 for a Japanese domestic car, and a 60,000 km major service at 20,000-35,000 against 8,000-12,000 - i.e. roughly 2-2.5x, which is the ratio this plan reproduces. Total 10-year spend NT$463,000 (~NT$6.6/km), about 2.5x what a RAV4-class Japanese car would cost over the same period.

assumptions.notes:
低里程車主：每年 6,000-8,000 km，取中位 7,000 km/年，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km/年。各檢查點 assumed_km = 7000 × years（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000）。

保養節奏：本次查核獨立重抓台北依德 BMW（yiderbmw.wordpress.com/bmw-service-extend/）並逐字確認兩點——「於授權服務中心完成每年或每一萬公里的定時定期保養」與「BMW提供您的新車2+1年不限里程保固服務」。在 7,000 km/年 下永遠碰不到 1 萬公里觸發點，因此保養完全由時間驅動，10 年正好進廠 10 次、累積約 70,000 km。

動力歸類：735i 為 3.0L 直列六缸渦輪（B58，2,998 c.c.、272 hp/5000 rpm）搭配 48V 輕油電（額外 18 hp）。48V 系統無法純電行駛，依本表規則歸為 gasoline 而非 hybrid（U-CAR 規格表本次獨立實抓，「汽油／直列6汽缸」逐字確認）。

稅金與保險依設計排除在外（供參考：U-CAR 規格表列本車燃料稅 7,200 元/年、牌照稅 15,210 元/年，兩者皆未計入）。

【查核新增的世代風險修正】G70 於 2022 年 12 月在台上市（U-CAR 內文確認），本車為 2026 年式 pre-LCI；G70 LCI 預期 2026-2027 年登場。原始記錄只在第 5 年才把「世代更替折價」計入，但那不成立——LCI 若在 2026-27 年登場，本車在自己的第 1-2 年就已經是 pre-LCI，折價會提前發生，不會等到第 5 年。前代 G11 的實價直接證明這個斷崖有多大：2019 年掛牌（LCI）730i 層峰旗艦版 50,000 km 開價 148.0 萬，2018 年掛牌（pre-LCI）730i Luxury 105,000 km 開價 85.8 萬，僅差一個年式、價差逾 40%（里程不同會放大，但方向與量級明確）。因此本次查核把第 1、3 年的殘值由「今天市場上還是現行世代的 G70 掛牌價」向下修正，理由與幅度寫在各 checkpoint 的 source。

purchase.source:
價格已由本次查核獨立重抓驗證，維持 4,930,000 不變（與原始記錄一致，誤差 0%）。實抓 U-CAR 新車規格表（newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/7%20series/6498/overall，HTTP 200）逐格確認表列內容：「735i Luxury｜493｜2,998｜汽油｜直列6汽缸｜八前速手自排｜後輪驅動｜272 hp/5000 rpm｜12.3 km/l｜燃7,200 / 牌15,210」，即建議售價 NT$4,930,000。同頁內文亦確認價格歷程：G70 於 2022 年 12 月導入台灣，燃油三車型 488 萬 735i Luxury / 595 萬 740i Luxury / 638 萬 740i Excellence，後調升為 493 萬 / 600 萬 / 640 萬（735i 與 740i Luxury 各漲 5 萬、740i Excellence 漲 2 萬，追加手機遙控停車）。735i Luxury 為台灣 7 Series 燃油版入門車型。

BMW Taiwan 官網（bmw.com.tw）本次查核亦獨立嘗試抓取，回傳 HTTP 000（連線失敗），與原始記錄的描述一致，確認並非誤述；因官網未提供任何內容，該 URL 已從 sources[] 移除，不列為來源。折讓與領牌費為台灣汎德經銷通路慣例推估，非官方公告。
purchase.notes:
動力與配備辨識：735i Luxury（G70，3.0L B58 直列六缸渦輪 2,998 c.c. + 48V 輕油電，272 hp / 40.8 kgm，後輪驅動，八速手自排，長軸單一車身）。48V 輕油電額外提供 18 hp 並改善油耗，但無法純電行駛，故 powertrain 記為 gasoline，此處註明 48V 系統（本表規則：48V mild hybrid 一律 gasoline）。

list_price 4,930,000 為現行官方建議售價（U-CAR 規格表本次獨立實抓）。

discounts 取 300,000（約 6.1%）：7 Series 是台灣年掛牌量極低的旗艦房車，庫存成本高、汎德與經銷商有實質議價空間，實務上以現金折讓 20-40 萬搭配配件與低利分期為常見組合。未比照量產車給更大折扣，是因為旗艦車單台毛利結構與走量車不同；本資料庫既有的 BMW X3 記錄為牌價 249 萬成交 218 萬（-12.4%），那是競爭最激烈的中型 SUV 級距，不宜套用。此幅度仍缺一份真正的 7 Series 成交菜單佐證，列為 open question。

onroad_fees 取 65,000 = 領牌規費約 5,000 + 代辦費約 5,000 + 交車配件約 55,000（高階隔熱紙、鍍膜、行車紀錄器、迎賓踏板、行李廂墊）。與本資料庫級距對齊：GLC 200（274 萬）取 40,000、Porsche Cayenne（419 萬）取 60,000，本車 493 萬取 65,000。

real_cost = 4,930,000 - 300,000 + 65,000 = 4,695,000。牌照稅與燃料稅依設計不計入。

售前整備／美容（內裝深度清潔、鍍膜、輪圈整理）
刊登費（8891 個人自售刊登）

selling_costs.notes: 取本級距上緣，查核後維持不變。過戶規費加代辦約 2,500；成本主要在售前整備：493 萬的旗艦房車自售時，買方對內裝皮革、水晶內裝套件、大尺寸輪圈與車漆的檢視標準遠高於一般車，不做深度美容會直接反映在成交價，9,000 為實務合理支出。刊登費以 8891 個人自售方案估 3,000。合計 14,500，落在本級距 6,000-15,000 區間上緣，符合旗艦車定位。

value_checkpoints.source:
【本次查核已下修】資料來源為 8891 中古車 G70 735i 實際掛牌（auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/7-series/735i，2026-08-12 獨立重抓，HTTP 200，解析出 n=14 筆，價格區間 10.8 萬~433.0 萬，與原始記錄描述一致）。近新車實際掛牌：2025 年掛牌 2025 款 735i Luxury / 3,000 km 開價 418.0 萬；2025 年掛牌 2026 款 735i Pure Excellence / 2,000 km 418.0 萬；2025 年掛牌 2026 款 735i M Edition / 3,000 km 433.0 萬；2024 年掛牌 2024 款 Luxury / 4,858 km 382.0 萬；2024 年掛牌 2025 款 Luxury / 4,000 km 382.0 萬。

【修正 1：車商開價基準】原始記錄取 415 萬，等於幾乎照抄那筆唯一的 1 年 Luxury 開價 418.0 萬。該筆有兩個問題：(a) 它是該車齡唯一一筆 Luxury 樣本；(b) 它的開價與更高階的 Pure Excellence 完全相同（同為 418.0 萬），顯示屬偏高的個別喊價，而非級距行情。相對地，兩筆 2024 年掛牌 Luxury 在 382.0 萬完全一致（n=2 互相印證），是更可靠的錨點。取 1 年車商開價 408 萬（高於 2 年群聚的 382 萬、低於單筆偏高的 418 萬）。

【修正 2：世代時點】今天的 1 年車仍是「現行世代」，本車滿 1 年時（2027）G70 LCI 預期已登場、本車已成 pre-LCI，故不能直接套用今天的行情，額外下修約 4%。

【車商售價 → 自售價】408 萬為車商零售開價（dealer retail asking），非車主拿得到的錢。旗艦房車庫存周轉慢、車商單台押的利息與毛利高，取價差區間高端 -15%：408 萬 × 0.85 ≈ 347 萬，再套世代時點 -4% ≈ 333 萬，記為 3,330,000（real_cost 的 70.9%）。dealer_tradein_price 取自售價 85% = 2,830,000。confidence 由原始記錄的 high 下修為 medium：掛牌樣本雖真實且多筆，但 private_sale_price 本身從未被觀測到，是換算值，且已再疊加世代時點判斷。

【本次查核已下修】8891 中古車 G70 735i Luxury 同世代同車型實際掛牌（auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/7-series/735i，2026-08-12 獨立重抓）。3 年車真實樣本：2023 年掛牌 735i Luxury / 44,000 km 318.8 萬、/ 53,000 km 318.8 萬、/ 76,000 km 279.8 萬（3 筆同價）；另 2022 年掛牌（約 3.7 年）735i Luxury / 24,000 km 299.8 萬。

【車商開價基準】本車主第 3 年僅 21,000 km，遠低於 44,000-76,000 km 的市場樣本，享有低里程溢價。兩條路徑收斂：(a) 由 44,000 km 的 318.8 萬往下修里程，約 +3~5% → 約 330 萬；(b) 由 3.7 年 / 24,000 km 的 299.8 萬往回推 0.7 年（本世代觀察到的年跌幅約 45 萬/年）→ 約 331 萬。取車商開價 330 萬。註：原始記錄取 325 萬，方向正確但略保守，此處依實價上修。

【修正：世代時點】此為對本記錄最實質的修正。原始記錄只在第 5 年才把世代更替折價計入，但本車 2026 年式為 pre-LCI、LCI 預期 2026-2027 登場，本車在第 3 年（2029）早已是上一世代，且次世代已在望。今天觀測到的 3 年行情屬「仍是現行世代」的 G70，直接套用會高估。前代 G11 的實價證明這個斷崖量級很大：2019 年掛牌（LCI）730i 層峰旗艦版 / 50,000 km 148.0 萬 vs 2018 年掛牌（pre-LCI）730i Luxury / 105,000 km 85.8 萬，僅差一個年式。故對第 3 年施加約 -8% 的 pre-LCI 折價。

【換算】330 萬 × 0.86（車商售價 → 自售價，-14%）≈ 284 萬，再乘 pre-LCI 折價 0.92 ≈ 261 萬，記為 2,610,000（real_cost 的 55.6%）。dealer_tradein_price 取自售價 85% = 2,210,000。confidence 由 high 下修為 medium：掛牌樣本真實且有 4 筆同世代同車型，但最終數字已疊加兩層判斷（自售換算、pre-LCI 折價），不再是可直接讀出的觀測值。

【外推，非同世代實價；查核後維持金額、調整 tradein】G70 於 2022 年 12 月才在台上市，市場上最老的同世代車僅約 3.7 年，第 5 年沒有同世代真實行情，依規則改用前代 G11（2016-2022）同齡低里程車的殘值比再套回本車 real_cost。前代實抓（auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/7-series/730i，2026-08-12 獨立重抓，HTTP 200，解析出 36 筆）：2022 年掛牌 730i 層峰旗艦版 / 13,000 km 199.0 萬（車齡 4 年、極低里程）；2021 年掛牌 730i 層峰旗艦版 / 99,000 km 143.0 萬（5 年、高里程）；2020 年掛牌 730i 層峰旗艦版 / 46,500 km 153.8 萬（6 年）。以本車主 35,000 km 的低里程條件內插，前代車齡 5 年的車商開價約 175 萬。

前代 LCI（2019 年小改）730i 層峰旗艦版原始新車價採約 430 萬——此為估計值，本次查核未能找到可驗證的官方或媒體價格頁（U-CAR 僅保留現行 G70 規格頁，前代頁面查無），故此分母仍是本檢查點最大的不確定來源，敏感度見 open questions。前代第 5 年低里程殘值比 ≈ (175 萬 × 0.87 自售換算) / 430 萬 ≈ 35.4%。

對照 G70 自身 1-3.7 年走勢外推約 46%，兩者差距主因是世代更替：今天的 G11 之所以殘值低，正因它已被 G70 取代，而本車在第 5 年（2031）同樣是上一世代（甚至已接近上兩世代）。加權後偏向前代比率，取 40.0% × 4,695,000 ≈ 1,880,000。dealer_tradein_price 由原始記錄的 83% 調整為 84% = 1,580,000，使其落在本表規定的「較自售價再低 10-15%」區間內。

【外推，非同世代實價；查核後維持金額、上修 tradein】第 7 年同世代資料不存在，改用前代 G11 同齡低里程車殘值比。前代實抓（auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/7-series/730i，2026-08-12 獨立重抓並逐筆核對）：2019 年掛牌（車齡 7 年）730i 層峰旗艦版 / 50,000 km 開價 148.0 萬、/ 53,000 km 開價 146.8 萬——這兩筆的里程幾乎正好等於本車主第 7 年的 49,000 km，是全表匹配度最高的樣本，原始記錄引用無誤；同年份較高里程者：93,000-94,000 km 開價 128.0-128.8 萬、120,000 km 開價 118.0 萬。

取車商開價 147 萬，以前代 LCI 車型原價約 430 萬（估計值，見第 5 年說明）計，自售換算 (147 萬 × 0.87) / 430 萬 ≈ 29.7%。套回本車 real_cost：29.8% × 4,695,000 ≈ 1,400,000。此時原廠 2+1 年不限里程保固早已結束（依德實抓確認），中古市場已把氣壓懸吊、後軸轉向等高價修繕風險折進價格，這是德系旗艦第 7 年之後續跌而非打平的結構性原因。dealer_tradein_price 由原始記錄的 81% 上修為 83% = 1,160,000：81% 已落在本表「較自售價再低 10-15%」的規定區間之外，屬過度折價。

【外推，但錨定在真實的 10 年車實價上；查核後維持金額、上修 tradein】第 10 年同世代資料不存在，改用前代 G11 同齡低里程車殘值比。前代實抓（auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/7-series/730i，2026-08-12 獨立重抓並逐筆核對）：2016 年掛牌（車齡正好 10 年）730i 樣本 7 筆——55,000 km 79.8 萬、55,700 km 79.8 萬、122,000 km 72.8 萬、130,000 km 68.8 萬、139,000 km 68.8 萬、148,300 km 69.8 萬、170,000 km 75.8 萬。原始記錄引用完全正確。本車主第 10 年為 70,000 km，介於 55,000 與 122,000 km 之間，內插得車商開價約 76 萬。

前代原始新車價在此有直接證據（本次查核已在原始 HTML 中逐字複驗）：同一批掛牌中一則 2016 款 730i 的車商標題自述「【新車價近 380 萬｜現在不用 80 萬入主】」，即 2016 款 730i 原價約 380 萬。故前代 10 年低里程殘值比 = (76 萬 × 0.87 自售換算) / 380 萬 ≈ 17.4%。套回本車：17.5% × 4,695,000 ≈ 820,000。

此比率是本資料庫德系車中最低的（對照 Porsche Cayenne 18.8%、BMW X3 23.8%、Mercedes GLC 26.6%），符合大型旗艦房車的市場現實：買家極少、修繕風險最高、屆時已落後兩個世代。dealer_tradein_price 由原始記錄的 78% 上修為 81% = 660,000：78% 明顯超出本表「較自售價再低 10-15%」的規定區間。10 年車齡的 7 Series 多數車商確實不願收，但那反映在「收不收」而非把收購價再壓到 -22%。

maintenance.plan_notes:
時間驅動，不是里程驅動。本次查核獨立重抓台北依德 BMW（yiderbmw.wordpress.com/bmw-service-extend/，HTTP 200）並逐字複驗兩件事：(a) 延長保固購買資格寫明「於授權服務中心完成每年或每一萬公里的定時定期保養」，即保養週期為兩者先到；(b)「BMW提供您的新車2+1年不限里程保固服務」即 3 年不限里程。在 7,000 km/年 下永遠觸發不到 1 萬公里，因此本車主 10 年只進廠 10 次年度保養，總里程約 70,000 km。

保養套餐與延長保固：BMW Service Inclusive（BSI）在台灣是付費選購而非新車附贈；依德的延長保固方案同樣要加價購，且資格要求在 36 個月保固到期前完成「新車保固到期檢查」並具備完整原廠保養紀錄。因此本表處理方式為：第 1-3 年只付保養工料、故障維修由原廠保固吸收（前期被保固補貼）；第 5、7、10 年一律以無補貼、全額自費計算，未假設車主購買延長保固。

為什麼 7 Series 的保養必然遠高於日系同級，也高於自家 X3：(1) 全車系標配「電子懸吊系統、前後軸自動水平氣壓式懸吊系統與整合式後軸轉向系統」——本次查核已在 U-CAR 規格頁原始 HTML 中逐字複驗這句話，確認為全車系標配而非選配。氣壓避震器與空氣壓縮機是 7 Series 在 8-10 年區間最典型的高價故障項，後軸轉向致動器同樣是高單價零件，這是 X3 xLine（鋼製彈簧）完全沒有的成本。(2) 3.0L B58 直列六缸的火星塞 6 支、點火線圈 6 顆，數量與工時都比四缸多；B58 的電子水泵、節溫器殼體、氣門室蓋墊片與機油濾芯座墊片漏油是已知的高齡項目。(3) 48V 輕油電的起動發電機與 48V 電池是額外的過保風險件。(4) BMW 標配失壓續跑胎（runflat），7 Series 用 19-21 吋大尺寸，單條原廠胎比同尺寸一般胎貴 25-40%，側邊受損不能補、只能整條換。(5) 車重逾 2 噸，煞車碟盤與來令片尺寸與單價都在 BMW 房車頂端。(6) 汎德對 7 Series 的工時費率是 BMW 車系中最高的一級。

【本次查核調整】10 年合計由原始記錄的 1,088,000 上修為 1,158,000（平均約 115,800/年），全部發生在第 10 年檢查點。原因：原始記錄的第 7-10 年區間只編列「氣壓避震器 2 支 + 空氣壓縮機 120,000」，且把後軸轉向與 48V 系統合併塞進籠統的風險備抵。G70 是前後軸皆為氣壓懸吊的四角系統，8-10 年區間漏氣後常需連同閥體一併處理，且整合式後軸轉向致動器與 48V 起動發電機都是應該被具名列出的高價過保風險件，不應只以綜合備抵帶過。

與本資料庫既有記錄對照：Porsche Cayenne 1,044,000、Mercedes GLE 300d 941,000、Mercedes GLC 200 480,000、BMW X3 462,000。本車高於 Cayenne 是合理的——Cayenne 該筆是標準配備版（氣壓懸吊為選配），而本車氣壓懸吊與後軸轉向皆為標配。

誠實聲明：第 1、3 年的年度保養單價可依 BMW 台灣公開的保養週期與級距推得，可信度較高；第 5、7、10 年的每一筆單價都是風險加權的判斷值，不是實際收據。本次查核同樣嘗試取得車主收據來源，Mobile01 回傳 HTTP 403 Forbidden，完全無法讀取，因此沒有任何一筆 7 Series 的真實維修收據支撐後期數字。原始記錄在 sources[] 列了一個無法驗證的 Mobile01 特定討論串 ID，本次查核已將其移除，改在此處誠實聲明「無法取得任何收據來源」。

checkpoints.source: 涵蓋第 7→10 年區間。全部為風險加權判斷值，非收據，本期不確定性最高。【本次查核已由 508,000 上修為 578,000】：原始記錄把氣壓懸吊估在 120,000（僅 2 支 + 壓縮機），並把整合式後軸轉向與 48V 系統壓在籠統的 35,000 風險備抵裡。G70 為前後軸皆氣壓的四角系統，漏氣後常需連同閥體處理，故上修為 150,000；後軸轉向致動器與 48V 起動發電機都是應具名列出的高單價過保件，分別獨立編列 45,000 與 30,000。金額仍按外廠／副廠件而非原廠件計算，若堅持原廠件會再高出一倍以上。轉外廠比例的假設反映實務：10 年車齡的 7 Series 車主極少再回原廠做大修。Mobile01 車主收據本次查核抓取回傳 HTTP 403，無法取得任何真實維修單據佐證。

sources.note: 主要價格來源。本次查核獨立重抓（HTTP 200）並在原始 HTML 中逐格複驗價格表列：「735i Luxury｜493｜2,998｜汽油｜直列6汽缸｜八前速手自排｜後輪驅動｜272 hp/5000 rpm｜12.3 km/l｜燃7,200 / 牌15,210」，即 NT$4,930,000，確認原始記錄的 list_price 正確、無需修正。同頁內文另複驗：G70 於 2022 年 12 月導入台灣，初期三車型 488/595/638 萬後調升為 493/600/640 萬；735i 與 740i 皆搭載 48V 輕油電（額外 18 hp），735i 為 272 hp、740i 為 381 hp；7 Series 與 i7 全車系「全面標配 My Mode 行車體驗模式切換、電子懸吊系統、前後軸自動水平氣壓式懸吊系統與整合式後軸轉向系統」（maintenance 後期高額項目的直接依據）；迎賓自動車門為 740i Luxury 以上才有，本車不含。註：WebFetch 對本頁回 403，需帶瀏覽器 UA 直接抓取才取得內容。

sources.note: 第 5、7、10 年外推的唯一實價基礎。本次查核獨立重抓（HTTP 200）並自行解析出 36 筆前代掛牌，逐筆核對原始記錄引用的樣本，全部屬實。關鍵樣本：2022 年掛牌（4 年）層峰旗艦版/13,000 km 199.0 萬；2021 年（5 年）層峰旗艦版/99,000 km 143.0 萬；2020 年（6 年）/46,500 km 153.8 萬；2019 年（7 年）層峰旗艦版/50,000 km 148.0 萬、/53,000 km 146.8 萬（里程與本車第 7 年的 49,000 km 幾乎完全吻合）；2018 年（8 年）Luxury/105,000 km 85.8 萬、/119,000 km 86.8 萬（此處出現 LCI 與 pre-LCI 的斷崖，是本次查核對第 1、3 年施加 pre-LCI 折價的實證依據）；2016 年（10 年）7 筆，55,000 km 79.8 萬 至 170,000 km 75.8 萬。前代原始新車價的直接證據也在此頁並已逐字複驗：一則 2016 款 730i 的車商掛牌副標自述「【新車價近 380 萬｜現在不用 80 萬入主】」，此即第 10 年殘值比 17.4% 的分母來源。註：前代 LCI（2019-2022）730i 層峰旗艦版的原始售價（本表採約 430 萬）在本頁沒有對應證據，仍是估計值。

sources.note: 本次查核獨立實抓（HTTP 200）作為車型涵蓋度的交叉檢查。可驗證的部分：735i 在售 14 筆、價格區間 10.8 萬~433.0 萬，與直接解析 735i 分頁的結果完全一致。原始記錄在此頁另引用了 740i n=24、730i n=70、740Li n=80、750Li n=12 等筆數，本次查核在該頁的伺服器端 HTML 中無法定位這些彙總數字，故不採用、也不在任何計算中依賴它們。

sources.name: 台北依德 BMW - 保修服務／依德延長保固方案
sources.note: maintenance 的關鍵制度來源。本次查核獨立重抓（HTTP 200）並逐字複驗：(a)「BMW提供您的新車2+1年不限里程保固服務；此外，所有 BMW 原廠非消耗性付費零件以及BMW原廠配件均不限里程」，即 3 年不限里程原廠保固；(b) 延長保固購買資格寫明「新車保固期(36個月內)結束前至BMW台北依德完成『新車保固到期檢查』」與「完整保養紀錄。(於授權服務中心完成每年或每一萬公里的定時定期保養)」，直接確認保養週期為「每年或每 1 萬公里先到者」——這是本表「7,000 km/年 下保養完全由時間驅動、10 年 10 次」的依據。因延長保固為加價購而非標配，本表第 5、7、10 年一律以全額自費計算。

assumptions.notes: 買家年行駛 6,000-8,000 km，遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km。各檢查點一律用 7,000 x 年數（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km）。因為里程極低，殘值採「同年份低里程車」而非里程盲的平均行情，保養則以「時間到期」而非「里程到期」為主軸（原廠 CBS 條件式保養在此里程下等同一年一次）。家用充電樁安裝（含電力申請與佈線，台灣行情約 NT$30,000-80,000）屬於擁車支出但不算保養，已刻意排除在 maintenance 之外；電費、稅金、保險亦全部排除。純電車在台使用牌照稅免徵至 2030/12/31，但依本表設計不計入。i4 eDrive40 為單馬達後驅、83.9 kWh 電池、340 hp、WLTP 600 km，屬純電（bev），非油電、非 48V。查核者註：殘值曲線已重建為德系前重式（year 1 一次跌 28%，其後年衰減約 12-14%，第 8 年高壓電池保固到期後尾段再加速到約 17%/年），取代原研究者「年衰減率隨車齡加速」的後重式曲線。

purchase.source: U-CAR 新車頻道 BMW i4 車款介紹（https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/i4/7059/overall）— 查核者以 curl 獨立抓取原始頁面驗證，內文明載「eDrive40 與 M60 xDrive 兩款車型…建議售價部分為 279 萬元與 333 萬元」。與研究者提供的 NT$2,790,000 完全一致（差異 0%），不需修正。
purchase.notes: list_price 2,790,000 為 2025 年 11 月上市之新年式建議售價，是 2026-08 台灣在售車型（價格軌跡：2022 首發 255 萬 → 2024/09 小改款 275 萬 → 2025/11 新年式 279 萬，導入碳化矽 SiC 逆變器、WLTP 續航增至 600 km）。discounts 150,000（約 5.4%）為判斷值而非官方公告：台灣純電豪華轎車買氣偏弱（8891 全台在售 i4 eDrive40 中古車僅 13 台，且其中同一台 6.4 萬 km 車重複刊登 4 次，週轉明顯偏慢），總代理汎德以「優惠選配 Racing Package」（M Sport 空力套件、藍色 M 煞車套件、18 吋 M 型輪圈、M 跑車化電子懸吊）作為主要讓利手段，現金加配件的實質讓利落在 12-18 萬區間，取中值 15 萬。查核者覆核：此值在合理帶內，維持不動。onroad_fees 70,000 = 新領牌照規費與臨時牌約 3,000 + 代辦服務費約 12,000 + 交車配件約 55,000（隔熱紙、行車紀錄器、腳踏墊、迎賓踏板、隨車攜帶式充電器）；純電車貨物稅全免已內含在建議售價，不另計。稅金與保險依設計排除。real_cost = 2,790,000 - 150,000 + 70,000 = 2,710,000。

items.name: 過戶代辦與監理規費
售前整備與美容（拋光鍍膜、內裝清潔、輪胎打氣、小鈑金修補）
8891 個人自售刊登費

selling_costs.notes: 以個人自售（非車商收購）為前提估算。280 萬級距的德系純電轎跑，買方對外觀細節挑剔，售前美容不能省，故整備費取 8,000 而非陽春的 3,000-4,000。合計 12,000，落在此級距 6,000-15,000 的合理帶內。若改走車商收購則過戶與刊登費由車商吸收，但售價要再往下修（見 dealer_tradein_price）。

value_checkpoints.source: 查核者獨立抓取並解析 8891 在售車列表（https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/i/i4-edrive40，2026-08-12，Next.js RSC payload，共 13 筆）。低里程實車車商開價：2025 年式 4,241 km 245.0 萬、2024 年式 3,500 km 243.0 萬、3,000 km 232.0 萬、5,900-5,978 km 228.0 萬 x3、9,000 km 218.0 萬。這些全部是「車商售價」且原始牌價為 275 萬（2024/09 小改款）。取真正低里程群的中位開價約 230 萬，套用 -15%（此級距週轉慢、庫存重複刊登，取 8-15% 帶的下緣）得自售約 195.5 萬，再對「本案是 2025/11 SiC 新年式、屆時將面對 Neue Klasse 新世代接手」做小幅前瞻下修，定 195 萬。車商收購 = 195 萬 x 0.867 ≈ 169 萬。修正說明：原研究者給 207 萬（對 real_cost 76.4%），屬豐田等級的保值率，非德系純電應有水準；同批德系純電對照組 year-1 落在 66-69%（EQE 66.5%、EQB 66.7%、EQA 69.1%），本案修正後為 72.0%，仍高於對照組以尊重 i4 確有實車支撐，但已脫離「高 70%」紅區。低里程已計入（一般 1 年車跑 12,000-15,000 km，本案僅 7,000 km）。

錨點是查核者親自抓取驗證的唯一成交訊號：8891 個別車輛頁 https://m.8891.com.tw/auto?id=4331289，payload 確認 makeYear 2022、modelEnName eDrive40、里程 2.59 萬 km、開價 183.0 萬、狀態「已售出」、原始牌價 255.0 萬 → 4 年車車商開價保值率 71.8%。姊妹車交叉驗證（https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/i/i4-m50，查核者自行解析）：真正的 2022 年式（4 年車）M50 為 3-3.6 萬 km 開價 189.0-191.0 萬，對 310 萬牌價僅 61.0-61.6%。兩者平均約 66-67% 的 4 年車商開價保值率。扣除「2022-2026 期間 i4 新車牌價由 255 萬漲到 279 萬（+9.4%）把中古行情一起墊高」這個不會重演的順風（x0.906），再以 -13% 由車商開價轉自售，得 4 年自售約 147 萬。本檢查點為 3 年，故定自售 150 萬；車商收購 = 150 萬 x 0.867 ≈ 130 萬。修正說明：原研究者宣稱 M50 的 4 年保值率為 71.6-73.5%，實際上他拿的是 2023 年式（3 年車，222-228 萬）去對 4 年的 eDrive40，年份錯置；真正的 4 年 M50 是 61%，姊妹車證據其實是「反駁」而非支持原曲線。原值 165 萬因此下修至 150 萬。

外推，無真實資料點：i4 台灣 2022 年才上市，市場上最老的只有 4 年車，5 年車尚不存在。以修正後的德系前重式曲線推進（year 1 -28.0%，其後穩定約 13%/年），自 3 年 150 萬推得 5 年自售 113 萬（對 real_cost 41.7%），車商收購 = 113 萬 x 0.854 ≈ 96.5 萬。理由：原廠 3 年不限里程保固（汎德，U-CAR news/article/10646）在第 3 年到期後，中古市場開始對德系純電的維修風險打折。同批對照組 year-5 為 34.8-43.5%（EQE 34.8%、EQB 42.6%、EQA 40.5%、EX40 43.5%），本案 41.7% 落在帶內。低里程（35,000 km，約一般車的一半）已給予正向調整。原研究者給 122 萬，因其 1-3 年曲線過於平緩而偏高，已隨整體曲線重建下修。

外推自「前代德系純電」而非憑空捏造：現行 i4 沒有 7 年車，改用 BMW i3 這台台灣唯一有長期資料的德系純電做保值率代理。查核者親自抓取並解析 8891 在售 i3（https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/i/i3，共 4 筆）：2017 年式 REX 14 萬 km 開價 52.0 萬、2016 年式 REX 8.3 萬 km 59.8 萬、2016 年式 REX 9 萬 km 45.8 萬；i3 純電版原牌價 239 萬、REX 版 299 萬（U-CAR news/article/23587）。i3 在 9-10 年殘存約牌價的 15-20%。把 5 年與 10 年兩端沿修正後曲線內插得 7 年自售 84 萬（對 real_cost 31.0%），車商收購 = 84 萬 x 0.851 ≈ 71.5 萬。此時車齡 7 年、原廠保固早過、高壓電池 8 年保固僅剩 1 年，中古市場已在對修復風險定價。同批對照組 year-7 為 26.3-34.5%，本案落在帶內。

外推自前代德系純電 BMW i3 的實際 10 年行情（查核者自行解析 8891，見上）：2016 年式 i3 REX（今年正好 10 年）開價 45.8-59.8 萬、里程 8.3-9.0 萬 km，對 REX 原牌價 299 萬為 15.3-20.0%。這些是車商開價，轉自售約 40-52 萬。i4 條件較佳（83.9 kWh、WLTP 600 km，2036 年仍屬堪用，不像 i3 的 22/33 kWh 那樣被續航淘汰；且本案 70,000 km 遠低於樣本 i3 的 8.3-14 萬 km），故取 48 萬（對 real_cost 17.7%），車商收購 = 48 萬 x 0.844 ≈ 40.5 萬。尾段刻意再加速（7→10 年約 -17.0%/年，高於 5-7 年的 -13.8%/年），反映第 8 年高壓電池保固到期後保固外修復風險被市場定價 — 尾段續跌而非打平，這正是德系純電與 Lexus 的差別。同批對照組 year-10 為 15.8-19.4%，本案落在帶內。

maintenance.plan_notes: 純電車無機油、無火星塞、無變速箱油，再生煞車也讓來令片壽命拉長，所以保養確實比同級燃油 BMW 便宜一大截 — 但絕不接近零。在年行 7,000 km 的條件下，保養節奏完全由「時間」而非「里程」決定：原廠 CBS 條件式保養實際上一年一次，煞車油每 2 年、冷卻液每 5 年、輪胎每 5-6 年（橡膠老化先到，里程根本跑不到磨耗極限），12V 輔助電瓶約 4-6 年一顆 — 這些都跟你開多少無關。保固結構：汎德 BMW 提供 3 年不限里程原廠保固（U-CAR news/article/10646），高壓電池 8 年/16 萬公里。注意這是「保固」不是「免費保養」：台灣的 BSI（BMW Service Inclusive）定期保養套餐是另外加購的，交車時常見的只有首次定保由經銷商吸收，故未把它當標配灌進前期。因此第 0-1 年幾乎不花錢、1-3 年在保固內只付耗材，但第 3 年保固到期後費用一次跳上來，5-10 年必須扛全額無補貼成本，包含德系車在台的高工資率（原廠約 NT$2,500-3,500/小時）與大尺寸煞車、輪胎。第 8 年電池保固也到期後，高壓系統（電子水泵、車載充電模組 OBC、電動壓縮機）成為真正的風險項，7-10 年期已編列預備金；若真的整組電池報廢，修復費會超過車輛殘值，那屬於報廢決策而非保養，不列在此表。全期 10 年合計約 NT$519,000 — 明顯低於同級燃油 BMW 4 系（免了機油、火星塞、水泵、點火線圈、節溫器外殼），但約為同級日系油電（10 年約 NT$200,000 量級）的 2.5-2.6 倍，符合德系應有的水準。交叉驗證：faqs.tw 2026 電動車保養整理給 BMW i4 五年 NT$73,000-140,000（以年 15,000 km 計），本表五年累計 NT$132,000 落在其區間上緣，合理 — 因為本表額外含一組輪胎與 12V 電瓶。查核者覆核：分期金額與項目經對照同批德系純電（EQE 573,000、EQB 571,000）後判定量級正確，未更動。

冷氣濾網更換
雨刷片

major_items: 第 2、3 年年度定保 x2（約 12,000）
煞車油更換（每 2 年，約 5,000）
冷氣濾網與雨刷（約 2,500）
四輪定位（約 3,000）
checkpoints.source: 仍在汎德 3 年不限里程保固期內，故障件由原廠吸收，此處只含自費耗材與工資。煞車油 2 年一換、BMW 原廠報價 NT$3,000-5,000（faqs.tw 電動車保養 2026 之 BMW 欄位）。21,000 km 尚未觸及任何里程門檻，全部是時間到期的項目。

四輪胎更換一組（18 吋，約 48,000）— 5 年橡膠老化到期，非里程磨耗
冷卻液（電池/馬達迴路，5 年期，約 10,000）
12V 輔助電瓶（AGM，約 12,000）
前煞車碟盤與來令片整理（台灣濕氣導致再生煞車少用而生鏽，約 8,000）
保固到期後的初期自費風險準備（約 8,000）
checkpoints.source: 此期第 3 年保固到期，費用結構整個改變。輪胎：i4 eDrive40 的 Racing Package 配 18 吋 M 型輪圈（U-CAR 車款介紹已驗證），車重逾 2 噸、實際車主多換 Pirelli P-Zero PZ4 等級，台灣一組行情 NT$40,000-60,000（faqs.tw 給 BMW 純電輪胎 NT$40,000-80,000），取 48,000。純電煞車片壽命 faqs.tw 記為 5 年一次，但本案 35,000 km 磨耗極輕，故只編列碟盤除鏽整理而非整組更換 — 這是低里程純電車在台灣的實際樣態。

major_items: 第 6、7 年年度定保 x2（約 14,000）
前後煞車碟盤與來令片整組更換（BMW 大尺寸碟，約 45,000）
冷氣濾網、雨刷、燈具耗材（約 6,000）
保固外風險項準備：電子水泵、冷氣壓縮機、避震器/M 跑車化電子懸吊阻尼器（約 45,000）
四輪定位與雜項（約 6,000）
checkpoints.source: 無真實 7 年 i4 資料，依德系純電保固外的已知風險項編列。電子水泵是 BMW 跨動力系統的常見故障件（純電車仍有電池與馬達冷卻迴路），單顆連工資約 NT$25,000；若選配 Racing Package 的 M 跑車化電子懸吊，阻尼器單支更換成本遠高於一般避震器。煞車碟盤在此車齡因再生煞車長期少用而鏽蝕，通常整組換掉而非磨到底。工資率以台灣 BMW 原廠約 NT$2,500-3,500/小時計。

major_items: 第二組輪胎（約 55,000）
12V 輔助電瓶第二顆（約 14,000）
懸吊系統：避震器、上座、控制臂襯套（2 噸重車，約 60,000）
高壓系統保固外風險：車載充電模組 OBC、電動壓縮機、電池冷卻迴路（約 70,000）
冷氣、門窗膠條、燈具等老化雜項（約 20,000）
checkpoints.source: 外推，且刻意編列得比一般日系高。關鍵時點：8 年/16 萬公里高壓電池保固在第 8 年到期，之後電池與其周邊（OBC、冷卻）全部自費，這是德系純電十年期成本的主要來源，也是中古市場對 7-10 年德系電動車重殺價的原因（見 BMW i3 十年僅剩牌價 15-20% 的實證）。此 265,000 不含整組電池更換 — 那筆錢會超過車輛殘值，屬報廢決策。參考代理車 BMW i3 在台的實際高齡維修樣態與 faqs.tw 對 BMW 純電「德系維修費較高、進口零件貴」的定性描述。

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, so every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7000/21000/35000/49000/70000) — roughly half the Taiwan average. At this mileage BMW's condition-based service is effectively TIME-driven, not distance-driven: the annual inspection, brake fluid (2-yr), coolant and cabin filters all come due on the calendar long before any km threshold, and tires age out (5-6 years) rather than wear out. Low mileage also means resale sits at the TOP of the observed listing band, which is how the value_checkpoints were positioned. EXCLUDED by design: 牌照稅, 燃料費, insurance, and electricity/charging. (Taiwan has granted BEVs a 使用牌照稅 exemption that has been extended in multi-year increments; the current end date was NOT verifiable from any page reachable in this environment, so no expiry date is asserted here — the tax is excluded by design either way.) ALSO EXCLUDED and deliberately not in maintenance: home wallbox installation — a BMW Wallbox plus 台電 電力申請 and conduit/wiring runs about NT$40,000-80,000 in TW and is a one-off ownership setup cost, not maintenance. High-voltage battery REPLACEMENT is likewise not budgeted in maintenance; at BMW TW that is a NT$800,000+ event, and rather than model it as a cost it is reflected as the repair-risk discount that keeps the year 7-10 resale falling.

purchase.source: List price INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED by this audit against U-CAR's BMW i5 model page (https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/i5/6967/overall), fetched successfully 2026-08-12. The page header reads 2 車型 / 329 - 485 萬 and the model table lists exactly two TW trims: eDrive40 M Sport 329萬 (純電動, 後輪驅動) and M60 xDrive 485萬 (純電動, 四輪驅動). The page body further states that when BMW TW published the new model year in July 2025 (SiC 碳化矽 inverters, i5 eDrive40 WLTP range 582 -> 627 km), 雙車系更新後售價配備不變, 轎車 eDrive40 為 329 萬、M60 為 485 萬 — the price was deliberately held. NT$3,290,000 CONFIRMED, 0% deviation, no change made. Discount and on-road fees are estimates, reasoned in notes, not quoted figures.
purchase.notes: POWERTRAIN: pure BEV, correctly classified. The U-CAR spec table (https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/i5/6967/spec) shows 動力系統 電動 / 能源 電能, a single 後置永磁同步馬達, 340 hp 綜效馬力, 43.9 kgm, 後輪驅動, 205 kW DC / CCS1, AC J1772, and a COMPLETELY EMPTY 引擎系統 section (no 缸徑, 衝程, 引擎型號, 引擎最大馬力). No combustion engine and no 48V question — 'bev' is right, not 'hybrid' or 'phev'. Importer 經銷/代理 汎德汽車股份有限公司 (Pan German Motors); 產地 德國. Kerb weight 2,120 kg on staggered 20-inch tires (輪胎尺寸 245/40 R20 front, 後輪尺寸 275/35 R20 rear) — both verified on the spec table, and both drive the tire and suspension line items later. BATTERY FIGURE CAVEAT: the U-CAR spec table states 電池總容量 83.9kwh / 可用電池容量 81.2kwh, but U-CAR's own article text on the overall page says the i5 uses a 可用容量 81.6kWh pack and that BMW never published a total capacity, noting 83.9/80.7 as the i4's figures. U-CAR contradicts itself; nothing in this record depends on which is right. TRIM: 'eDrive40 M Sport' is the only eDrive40 sedan spec sold in TW; the sole sedan alternative is M60 xDrive at 485萬, so there is no cheaper i5 sedan to confuse this with. DISCOUNT of NT$240,000 (7.3%): estimate, not a quoted deal. Justification — the price has been held at 329萬 across two model years while the product improved, which in TW is the classic signature of a list price being defended while real movement happens as dealer discount and accessory bundling. Demand is visibly thin: 27 used i5 eDrive40 are listed on 8891 for a car whose earliest TW registrations are 2024款, an unusually high churn rate. BMW's Neue Klasse 800V i-models are also approaching, and the i5 is explicitly still a 400V car (U-CAR: i5 全車系皆仍架構於 400V 電壓、尚未是 Neue Klasse 平臺 800V 電壓架構), which softens it further. NT$200,000-280,000 in cash plus accessory value is the realistic band at this class; 240,000 is the midpoint. ON-ROAD FEES of NT$105,000 = 新領牌照登記費/號牌/行照 規費 roughly NT$2,500 + 代辦領牌服務費 roughly NT$12,000 + 配件 roughly NT$90,000 (隔熱紙, 行車紀錄器, 全車鍍膜, 腳踏墊/精品 — a normal delivery package at the 300萬+ level). Commodity tax and 牌照稅 treatment for BEVs was not verifiable from any reachable page and is not asserted; in any case list_price is the 建議售價 as published, and tax and insurance are excluded from this model by design. real_cost = 3,290,000 - 240,000 + 105,000 = 3,155,000 (arithmetic verified).

items.name: 過戶代辦費 + 監理規費 (title transfer)

The 8891 BMW listing payload (https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/i5, fetched 2026-08-12) carries a model facet reading exactly {"count":27,"maxPrice":"253.0萬","minPrice":"209.8萬","name":"i5 eDrive40"} — 27 live listings of this exact trim at NT$2,098,000-2,530,000. Near-observed, extrapolated about half a year past the oldest real i5. The bottom of the verified 8891 i5 eDrive40 band, NT$2,098,000, is a 2024款 car at roughly 2-2.5 years. Corroborated by sibling German BEVs verified in the same payload by this audit: iX xDrive40 {"count":4,"minPrice":"195.5萬","maxPrice":"213.0萬"} at about 3.5 years against a ~338萬 list = 58-63% dealer-retail retention, which brackets the ~61% implied here; i4 eDrive40 {"count":13,"minPrice":"188.0萬","maxPrice":"245.0萬"}. This audit uses the same-class predecessor instead, the G30 5 Series, from rows extracted at https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/5-series: 2019 520i 8.11萬公里 83.9萬 and 2019 520i 11.9萬公里 88.9萬 (7 yr, ~31-33% of the 520i's ~268萬 list), and 2018 530i xDrive 12.4萬公里 110.8萬 (8 yr, ~33% of its ~338萬 list). ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 11.5% off gives private-sale NT$905,000; a further 14.4% gives trade-in NT$775,000. EXTRAPOLATED — no 10-year-old i5 exists. LOWERED BY THIS AUDIT from the researcher's NT$650,000, which was the clearest substantive error in the record: it had the BEV RETAINING MORE at 10 years than its own ICE predecessor, after an explicit undisclosed-magnitude upward nudge, which contradicts the German-BEV thesis the same record argues. (a) ICE, same class: from https://auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/5-series this audit extracted 2016 520i 9.98萬公里 46.9萬 and 2016 520i 8.3萬公里 43.0萬 — a 10-year F10 5 Series at ~17-18% of its ~258萬 list at dealer retail. (b) BEV, wrong class but right powertrain: the 8891 BMW payload facet {"count":4,"minPrice":"45.8萬","maxPrice":"59.8萬","name":"i3"} on 2014-2017 cars = ~19-25% of the i3's ~239萬 original list at 9-12 years. The two bracket 10-year retention at 17-25% of list. This record takes 20% of real_cost = about NT$630,000 dealer retail: above the ICE sedan floor because 70,000 km is genuinely low and an 81 kWh pack is not range-obsolete the way a 22 kWh i3 is, but below the i3's ratio because a NT$800,000+ HV battery replacement risk on a 329萬 car is a far larger absolute threat than on a 239萬 one. ADJUSTMENT APPLIED: 11.5% off gives private-sale NT$560,000; a further 15.2% gives trade-in NT$475,000. That is 17.7% of real_cost with no flattening — by now the HV battery warranty has expired and the market prices replacement risk into every offer. CAVEAT CARRIED FORWARD: the i3's original TW list price (~239萬) could NOT be verified from any page reachable in this environment, so limb (b) rests on unverified knowledge; limb (a) is fully sourced, which is why the two are used together rather than either alone.

maintenance.plan_notes: At 7,000 km/year the schedule is entirely TIME-DRIVEN, not mileage-driven — the car reaches 70,000 km only at year 10, so the annual inspection, the 2-year brake fluid, the coolant service and the cabin filters all fall due on the calendar. BEV economics are genuinely much cheaper than the combustion 5 Series: no engine oil, no oil filters, no spark plugs, no DPF, and regenerative braking means pads last far longer. But nowhere near zero, and materially above a Japanese equivalent. Three things keep it expensive: (1) a 2,120 kg kerb weight on staggered 20-inch tires (245/40 R20 front, 275/35 R20 rear, both verified on the U-CAR spec table) that cannot be rotated front-to-rear, so a set is roughly NT$68,000-72,000 fitted and ages out every 5-6 years at this mileage; (2) BMW TW dealer labour rates; (3) a heavy self-levelling rear suspension provision, treated as a live NT$45,000-90,000 risk item from year 6 onward. SUSPENSION SOURCING CORRECTION: the original record asserted that standard self-levelling REAR AIR SUSPENSION was 'confirmed on the U-CAR spec table'. It is NOT. That table's only suspension entries are 前輪懸吊 雙A臂 and 後輪懸吊 多連桿 — multi-link geometry, with no air-spring field at all. BMW fits self-levelling rear air suspension as standard to the i5 in most markets and the claim is very likely true of the TW car, but it is unverified here and the false attribution has been removed. The provision is retained either way: at 2,120 kg, a rear air unit that fails or a set of conventional heavy-duty dampers and springs are both real money at a BMW dealer. WARRANTY AND PACKAGE — IMPORTANT CAVEAT: BMW Taiwan's standard cover is 3年不限里程 vehicle warranty plus 8年/160,000公里 on the high-voltage battery, and 汎德 has historically bundled a multi-year BMW Service Inclusive scheduled-maintenance package with i-series cars. This audit INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED that www.bmw.com.tw is unreachable from this environment (curl returns exit status 000 on both the homepage and the BMW Service Inclusive path), so the current package terms could not be checked and the researcher's honesty note on this is upheld. Because the package is unverified, this audit RAISED the year-1 and year-3 figures above the researcher's near-zero numbers to avoid under-modelling a German car on an unconfirmed subsidy. Every period from year 3 onward carries the full unsubsidised dealer cost with no package offset. HV BATTERY REPLACEMENT IS NOT BUDGETED HERE — see assumptions.notes; it is modelled as resale-value risk instead. Charger installation is likewise excluded. Ten-year maintenance total is NT$825,000 (the original record stated NT$818,000 against line items summing to NT$813,000 — an arithmetic slip, now corrected and consistent).

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year; every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000), roughly half the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/yr. At this mileage BMW's condition-based service is effectively TIME-driven (annual), not distance-driven, and 255/50 R21 tyres age out on rubber hardening (~5-6 years) long before they wear out. Low-mileage cars sell above the mileage-blind average, so every value figure is quoted against the low-mileage end of the observed listing bands and carries a modest premium. EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: vehicle licence tax and fuel tax (BEVs are currently exempt in TW anyway), insurance, and electricity/charging. ALSO EXCLUDED: home AC charger purchase and installation (typically NT$40,000-120,000 in TW depending on whether the building's electrical riser needs upgrading and whether a separate meter is required) - that is a one-off ownership/setup cost, not maintenance, so it appears in neither purchase nor maintenance. Public DC fast-charging fees are likewise excluded. High-voltage battery REPLACEMENT is also not budgeted as maintenance; at BMW TW that would exceed the car's residual value from year 7 onward, so it is modelled as the repair-risk discount that keeps the year 7-10 resale falling rather than as a line item. Kerb weight 2,450 kg and 255/50 R21 tyres on all four corners are the two verified facts that drive consumable cost hardest.
