The scout's NT$2,250,000 is the superseded 2025 model-year price. Note U-CAR's own spec table header still reads '225 - 289 萬' while its body text documents the December 2025 rise, so that page contradicts itself; the Yahoo 2026 table resolves it in favour of 226萬. Discount level judged from BMW Taiwan's live August 2026 campaign 'BMW仲夏禮遇', confirmed present on Yahoo Autos (dated Aug 10-11, 2026), which pays in kind rather than cutting list price.
purchase.notes: 48V MILD HYBRID: B38 1.5L TwinPower turbo 3-cylinder + ISG 48V starter-generator. U-CAR confirms 'sDrive20i 採代號 B38 的 1.5 升 TwinPower Turbo 直列 3 缸汽油渦輪引擎搭配 ISG 48V 輕油電系統，引擎本體具有 156 匹最大馬力、24.5 公斤米扭力'; the ISG adds up to 19 hp for 170 hp combined. It cannot drive on electricity alone, so it is 'gasoline' for this table, not 'hybrid'. WARNING: BOTH 8891 AND Yahoo Autos mislabel this trim - Yahoo's own 2026 spec line reads '1499cc | 156hp@4700rpm | 油電混合'. Any table built by scraping either site would misclassify this car as a hybrid. DISCOUNT NT$100,000: BMW Taiwan (汎德) does not publish cash discounts; the live 'BMW仲夏禮遇' campaign pays in kind - 0% finance, a 晶華酒店 three-day package stated by the campaign as worth over NT$30,000, one year of comprehensive insurance on designated models, and a 3-year/40,000 km factory service package on designated model years. On a low-volume, slow-selling model a realistic negotiated cash-plus-accessory concession is NT$50,000-120,000; NT$100,000 is the mid-point. Buyers on 8891's 菜單 board post budgets of 198-200萬 for this exact trim (26-28萬 off list), which is aspirational and not achievable in practice. The insurance giveaway is deliberately NOT counted (insurance is excluded by design) and the service package is reflected in maintenance, not in the price. ON-ROAD FEES NT$65,000 = 領牌+代辦 ~NT$15,000 + 配件/精品 (window film, dashcam, floor mats, paint coating) ~NT$50,000, scaled to a 226萬 imported SUV. Tax (牌照稅 7,120 + 燃料稅 4,800/yr) and insurance are EXCLUDED. real_cost = 2,260,000 - 100,000 + 65,000 = 2,225,000.

selling_costs.notes: Costs the owner pays to sell privately, which is the channel assumed in private_sale_price. Detailing is set at the higher end of normal because a German premium SUV with 19-inch wheels and Veganza upholstery needs a proper pre-sale clean to reach the private-sale prices quoted. Total sits in the expected NT$6,000-15,000 band for this class. If the owner instead trades in to a dealer most of these costs disappear, which is part of why dealer_tradein_price is quoted separately.

value_checkpoints.source: REAL LISTINGS, current generation (U10), re-verified line by line by this fact-check against the live 8891 nationwide X2 listing (auto.8891.com.tw/bmw/x2). Seven 2025-registered sDrive20i M Sport cars are on sale at DEALER RETAIL asking prices of 183.8萬 (9,000 km), 183.8萬 (14,000 km), 186.0萬 (8,800 km), 188.8萬 (14,000 km), 189.8萬 (3,500 km), 190.0萬 (3,000 km) and 195.0萬 (3,273 km), plus two more at 電洽 (one a CPO 認證車). ADJUSTMENT MADE: the private-sale figure is set 13% BELOW a conservative 186.0萬 dealer-retail pick - not below the 188.8萬 median of those seven - giving NT$1,620,000; the 13% haircut is the wide end of the 8-15% band, justified by genuinely thin U10 demand and by the fact that asking prices on a ten-car nationwide market are sticky rather than market-clearing. Dealer trade-in is set a further 13% below private at NT$1,405,000. Do NOT read the 186萬 asking figure as owner proceeds. Mileage matched: our 7,000 km sits inside the observed 3,000-14,000 km band, so no mileage extrapolation was needed.

INTERPOLATED between two verified anchors - no genuine 3-year U10 exists (the generation reached Taiwan in 2024). Anchor A (real, verified on 8891 today): a 2024-build sDrive20i M Sport with 9,000 km asks NT$1,728,000 dealer retail, i.e. 76.8% of the 225萬 it was sold at. Anchor B: the 5-year dealer-asking level of ~NT$1,050,000 derived below. A geometric decay between them is 0.847/year, putting 3-year DEALER ASKING at ~NT$1,460,000; that is shaded to ~NT$1,445,000 because German compact SUVs fall hardest in years 1-3. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private = 12% below dealer asking (NT$1,270,000); dealer trade-in = 13% below private (NT$1,105,000). CORRECTION TO PRIOR DRAFT: an earlier version put this point at NT$1,335,000, anchored on 8891's own list-anchored 持有3年預估折舊後價值 of 159.3萬. That produced a curve in which the car lost MORE per year between years 3 and 5 (NT$202,500/yr) than between years 1 and 3 (NT$142,500/yr) - i.e. depreciation accelerating with age, the opposite of the front-loaded German shape. 8891's residual model is anchored to list price and is not a market observation, so it was dropped as an anchor.

PREDECESSOR-GENERATION RATIO TRANSFER (F39 X2, 2018-2023) - no 5-year U10 exists. All comparators re-verified on 8891 today. Real 5-year F39 dealer asking: 2021 sDrive18i Sport Edition 30,000 km NT$928,000; 60,000 km NT$888,000; 52,000 km NT$838,000; 80,200 km NT$798,000 - against its original TW list of NT$1,880,000 (Yahoo Autos 2021 X2 table, verified: 'sDrive18i Sport Edition 188'), i.e. 42-49% retention with the low-mileage 30,000 km car at 49.4%. The 18i is the cheap base trim and always retains a higher PERCENTAGE, so the 20i is priced off its own comparator: a 6-year 2020 sDrive20i M Sport 領航版 with 33,000 km asks NT$880,000 against its NT$2,180,000 list (Yahoo Autos 2020 X2 table, verified: 'sDrive20i M Sport領航版 218') = 40.4%. Interpolating that 20i point back one year to 5 years gives ~46% of list; applied to this car's NT$2,260,000 list that is ~NT$1,050,000 dealer retail asking. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private = 12% below (NT$925,000); dealer trade-in = 14% below private (NT$795,000). Our 35,000 km closely matches the 30,000-33,000 km comparators, so the low-mileage premium is already embedded. Confidence low because the ratio is transferred from the previous generation.

EXPLICITLY EXTRAPOLATED from the predecessor F39 X2 - no 7-year U10 exists and none can. All comparators re-verified on 8891 today. Real F39 asking prices: 2019 sDrive20i M Sport 100,000 km NT$789,000 and 2019 M Sport X 128,000 km NT$749,000, against a NT$2,150,000 original list (Yahoo Autos 2018 X2 table, verified: 'sDrive20i M Sport X 215') = 34.8-36.7%. IMPORTANT CORRECTION TO PRIOR DRAFT: the low-mileage premium in this age band is much weaker than first claimed. A 2018 M Sport X with only 15,000 km asks NT$788,000 while the same trim at 70,000 km asks NT$778,000 and at 80,000 km asks NT$688,000 - so 55,000 km of extra mileage is worth about NT$10,000, not the '+4 to +5 retention points' originally asserted. Old F39 asking prices cluster at NT$680,000-790,000 almost regardless of odometer. Applying ~38% of list (not 39%) to NT$2,260,000 gives ~NT$858,000 dealer retail asking at 7 years. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private = 12% below (NT$755,000); dealer trade-in = 15% below private (NT$640,000). Confidence low: ratio transferred from the previous generation, and the car is out of warranty here so the used market prices in repair risk - the German tail keeps falling rather than flattening.

EXPLICITLY EXTRAPOLATED, CROSS-MODEL - no 10-year X2 of any generation exists (the F39 reached Taiwan in 2018, so the oldest X2 on the road today is ~8 years). Proxy: BMW X1 F48 (2016-2022), the closest BMW front-drive compact SUV on the same platform family, whose 2016 builds are exactly 10 years old now. Verified on SUM 汽車網 today: a 2016 F48 X1 2.0L with 76,690 km asks NT$478,000 (listing carinfo-641144, 君豪汽車, 高雄市), with a 101,150 km car in the same search, against a NT$1,970,000 original list (Yahoo Autos 2016 X1 table) = ~24-27%. Sanity-checked against the oldest real X2 data: 8-year 2018 F39 sDrive20i M Sport X cars ask NT$688,000-788,000 = 32-37% of their 215萬 list, so a further fall to ~26% by year 10 is consistent rather than assumed. Our buyer's 70,000 km is at or below every comparator, so the top of the band applies, shaded slightly down because the X2's coupe-SUV body has thinner used demand in Taiwan than the X1's. Ratio used ~26% of list = ~NT$586,000 dealer retail asking. ADJUSTMENT MADE: private = 13% below (NT$510,000); dealer trade-in = 16% below private (NT$430,000). Confidence low: this is a cross-model, cross-generation transfer, stated openly rather than invented.

maintenance.plan_notes: SERVICING IS TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN. At 7,000 km/year the car needs an annual oil service long before it reaches BMW's Condition Based Service mileage triggers (~20,000-25,000 km for an oil service), so every period below is costed on an annual-visit basis and consumables are replaced on AGE, not wear - most importantly the 225/50 R19 run-flat tyres, which are replaced roughly every 5-6 years because rubber ages out well before it wears out at this mileage. WARRANTY AND SERVICE PACKAGE: BMW Taiwan's standard cover is a 3-year unlimited-mileage factory warranty. 8891's X2 page lists a 廠商優惠 of 贈3年/4萬公里原廠保養套裝 and BMW Taiwan's live August 2026 'BMW仲夏禮遇' campaign (verified on Yahoo Autos, articles dated 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-11) confirms a 3年/4萬公里 factory service package as a live incentive. CAUTION: that package is flagged 指定年式車型 - it is a campaign incentive, NOT a standard entitlement, so it is NOT safe to assume the buyer secures it. Years 1 and 3 below are therefore priced as a BLEND: mostly-covered if the package is obtained (at 7,000 km/year only 21,000 km of the 40,000 km allowance is used, so the whole 0-3 year window would be covered on both time and mileage), but carrying real out-of-pocket risk if it is not. An earlier draft assumed the package was definitely secured and priced years 1 and 3 at NT$6,000 and NT$18,000; those have been raised to NT$10,000 and NT$26,000, in line with the directly comparable BMW X1 sDrive20i record on the same FAAR platform. If the package is definitely NOT obtained, expect roughly NT$25,000 and NT$70,000 instead. Periods 3-5, 5-7 and 7-10 carry the FULL unsubsidised BMW dealer cost with no package and no warranty. HONESTY NOTE: no published BMW Taiwan service price table could be obtained (bmw.com.tw is a JS shell that returns no pricing; dealer sites 汎德永業 and 桃園大桐 publish none; Mobile01 thread bodies are blocked by Akamai; general web search was unavailable this session). 8891's own 用車成本 page for this exact trim states 保養：暫無數據 for the same reason. The 3-10 year figures are therefore a parts-and-labour build-up at BMW Taiwan dealer rates (工時 roughly NT$2,500-3,500/hr) rather than a quoted table, and are marked low confidence. LATER-PERIOD RISK ITEMS deliberately included, as they are the well-known B38/48V failure points once out of warranty: electric water pump, thermostat housing, ignition coils, 7-speed DCT gearbox oil, AGM 12V battery (twice over 10 years), the 48V ISG starter-generator and its lithium module, suspension bushes and dampers, and valve-cover/sump oil leaks. Two full sets of 19-inch run-flat tyres fall inside 10 years. Total 10-year maintenance is ~NT$647,000, roughly double a Japanese equivalent of the same size - that gap is the real story of this car.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, far below the Taiwan average of ~12,000-15,000 km/year. Every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). At this mileage BMW's CBS condition-based servicing is driven by the 12-month clock, not the mileage trigger, so the car takes roughly one service per year regardless of distance and the cost profile is dominated by items that age out (fluids, rubber, batteries, tyre sidewalls) rather than wear out. Used-value estimates are anchored on genuinely low-mileage listings, not on mileage-blind averages. Tax and insurance are EXCLUDED by design from every figure here; for reference only, U-CAR's spec table (re-fetched directly this round, HTTP 200) lists 牌照稅 15,210/yr and 燃料費 4,320/yr for this car — the 4,320 looked wrong at first glance but is correct, because Taiwan's 汽車燃料使用費 charges diesel vehicles on a much lower scale than petrol (the sibling 2,998cc petrol xDrive40i on the same U-CAR table is charged 7,200). POWERTRAIN CLASSIFICATION: U-CAR's spec table states 動力系統 48V輕油電混合 / 能源 柴油. The 48V ISG (Integrated Starter-Generator) mild-hybrid adds about 9kW on acceleration but cannot move the car on electricity alone, so this is NOT a 'hybrid'. The batch rule's literal wording maps 48V systems to 'gasoline', but that clause exists to stop MHEVs being called hybrids and is written around petrol MHEVs; calling a 2,993cc turbodiesel 'gasoline' would be factually false. Classified 'diesel', which is also the convention already used by the sibling record in this batch for the Mercedes GLE 300 d 4MATIC — another 48V diesel MHEV. The 48V hardware is documented in purchase.notes and carried as an explicit out-of-warranty risk item in the year-7 and year-10 maintenance windows. Low annual mileage is a specific negative for this diesel: short, cold, low-speed urban trips are the worst case for DPF (diesel particulate filter) regeneration, and that risk is priced into the later maintenance periods.

purchase.source: LIST PRICE INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED AND CONFIRMED CORRECT. Direct fetch of https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/x5/7170/overall (HTTP 200) returns a two-trim Taiwan lineup — 'xDrive30d M Sport鉑金版 354 / 2,993 c.c. / 柴油 / 直列6汽缸 / 八前速手自排 / 四輪驅動 / 286 hp/4000 rpm / 13.2 km/l' and 'xDrive40i M Sport鉑金版 399' — with body text confirming 'BMW 在 2026 年 4 月發表新年式 BMW X5 與 X6 鉑金版 ... 售價分別為 354 萬元 (較原先 xDrive30d xLine 車型漲 9 萬元) 和 399 萬元'. NT$3,540,000 stands, no change. The spec page https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/x5/7170/spec (HTTP 200) was also fetched fresh and confirms 動力系統 48V輕油電混合 / 能源 柴油, 車重 2,220 kg, and tyre sizes 275/45 R20 front, 305/40 R20 rear. DISCOUNT RAISED from the researcher's 100,000 to 200,000 — see notes. On-road figure is an estimate, not a quoted transaction.
purchase.notes: list_price 3,540,000 = official 建議售價 for the 2026 鉑金版, launched April 2026, so only ~4 months on sale at the 2026-08-12 valuation date. POWERTRAIN: 2,993cc inline-6 turbodiesel, 286hp/4000rpm, 8-speed auto, xDrive AWD, paired with a 48V ISG mild-hybrid (U-CAR spec: 48V輕油電混合 / 柴油). Classified 'diesel', not 'hybrid' and not 'gasoline' — see assumptions.notes for the reasoning. The 48V starter-generator and its lithium battery are out-of-warranty risk parts, carried in the year-7 and year-10 maintenance windows. DISCOUNTS RAISED 100,000 -> 200,000 (2.8% -> 5.6%). This is the main purchase-side correction. The researcher's 2.8% is out of line with BMW Taiwan's own documented behaviour: the sibling BMW record in this same batch (G45 X3 20 xDrive xLine) is built on a PTT 菜單 showing 249萬 list transacting at 218-220萬, i.e. roughly 12% off, with the thread's own commenters calling that merely average rather than generous. 汎德 discounts, and a near-zero discount assumption for the brand is the wrong default. The direct segment rival in this batch, the Mercedes GLE 300 d 4MATIC at 343萬 list, carries 150,000 (4.4%). 200,000 is set above the GLE because BMW Taiwan discounts harder than 台灣賓士, and well below the X3's 12% because the X5 is a low-volume halo model, the 鉑金版 is only four months old, and much of the benefit at this price point genuinely arrives as bundled accessories, an extended service package or first-year insurance rather than as cash off list. HONESTY NOTE: no 2026 X5 菜單 was reachable this round — the session's WebSearch budget was exhausted before this audit began and both DuckDuckGo HTML and Bing returned generic non-responsive result sets for X5 pricing queries — so 200,000 is a reasoned brand-level judgement, not a quoted transaction, and it remains the softest input in this record. ONROAD_FEES 105,000 (~3.0% of list) = 領牌規費 + 代辦費 (~15,000-20,000) plus the accessory pack a buyer at this price point actually fits: window tint for a large SUV (~35,000), dashcam (~18,000), paint coating (~25,000), side steps/mats/trims (~10,000). Comparable to the GLE 300 d's 120,000 on a 343萬 car. Tax and insurance excluded by design. real_cost = 3,540,000 - 200,000 + 105,000 = 3,445,000.

selling_costs.notes: Reviewed and left unchanged — items sum to 13,000, matching total. Costs the OWNER pays to complete a private sale, sized for a 350萬-class German SUV. 過戶費 covers the monitoring-station transfer fee plus an agent to handle it. Pre-sale prep is the largest item: at this price a buyer expects a properly detailed car, so interior deep-clean, machine polish and touch-up of stone chips are effectively mandatory to hold the asking price. 刊登費 is 8891 個人自售 listing exposure. Total 13,000 sits in the upper half of the 6,000-15,000 band because the car is large (20-inch staggered wheels, big panel area) and the buyer pool expects presentation. Excludes any dealer commission — these figures assume the private sale route that private_sale_price reflects.

value_checkpoints.source: LOWERED from the researcher's 2,620,000, and confidence downgraded from high to medium. The underlying 8891 crawl (192 unique BMW X5 listings after de-duplication, re-analysed independently this round from the cached crawl at /tmp/x5all.json) does support diesel comps at 車商售價 292.0萬 for 2025-registered 'X5 2025款 xDrive30d xLine 3.0L' at 3,800 km and 3,816 km, plus a '2025款 2025 30D' at 292.0萬/3,000 km. TWO PROBLEMS WITH LEANING ON THAT NUMBER. (1) All three are the same 292.0萬 price point and the researcher's own open_questions concede they are syndicated copies of probably one or two physical cars — so the diesel age-1 anchor is a single observation, not a cluster. (2) 292.0萬 against the xDrive30d xLine's verified 345萬 list is 84.6% retention on a one-year-old German diesel SUV, which is a Toyota-shaped number and reflects the well-known padding of the near-new asking segment. METHOD USED INSTEAD: anchor on the deeper petrol set. The same crawl holds five 2025-registered xDrive40i M Sport listings at 328.0/328.0/325.0/319.0/308.0萬 across 3,000-9,000 km; against that trim's 392萬 list those run 83.7% / 83.7% / 82.9% / 81.4% / 78.6%, median ~82.9%. Taking ~82% of list as the dealer RETAIL ask gives 3,540,000 * 0.82 = ~2,900,000. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: 車商售價 is what a dealer asks, not what an owner receives, so private_sale_price is set 12% BELOW that dealer ask = 2,550,000; dealer_tradein_price is a further 12.5% below the private figure = 2,230,000. Mileage needed no separate premium — the comps sit at 3,000-9,000 km against this buyer's 7,000 km. RESULT: 74.0% of real_cost, in line with the German cohort in this batch (GLC 74.0%, Q5 73.7%, X3 74.2%, Cayenne 75.3%) and a few points above the GLE 300 d's 70.6%, which is defensible given the X5's stronger class position and this buyer's very low mileage. Confidence medium, not high: the diesel anchor is one syndicated car, the working anchor is a different fuel and trim scaled across, and every figure is an ask rather than a transaction.

Essentially confirmed, nudged from 2,100,000 to 2,080,000, confidence downgraded high -> medium. This remains the best-evidenced point in the record and my independent re-analysis of the cached 8891 crawl reproduces it. Real comps at 2023 registration ('X5 2024款 xDrive30d xLine 3.0L', the direct predecessor trim): 車商售價 243.0萬 at 20,400 km and 243.0萬 at 20,500 km — essentially this buyer's exact 21,000 km. Petrol cross-check from the same crawl: 2023-registered xDrive40i M Sport at 275.0萬/18,000 km. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: 243.0/345 = 70.4% dealer retail retention for the diesel; 275.0/392 = 70.2% for the petrol — two independent reads converging within 0.2 points, which is the tightest agreement anywhere in this dataset. Trimmed to 68% because 2023-registered cars are ~2.5-3.0 years old rather than a full 3.0 and because dealer asks are sticky: 3,540,000 * 0.68 = ~2,410,000 dealer RETAIL. private_sale_price set ~13.5% below that dealer ask = 2,080,000 (the extra half-point versus year 1 reflects that asks at this age have had longer to go stale). dealer_tradein_price a further 12.5% below = 1,820,000. That is 60.4% of real_cost, a 13.6-point fall from year 1 — front-loaded, as the German pattern requires, and close to the GLE 300 d's 59.4%. Confidence lowered to medium rather than high because the two 243.0萬 entries are very likely syndicated copies of one physical car, the comps are the xLine trim scaled up to M Sport 鉑金版, and asks are not transactions.

Confirmed at essentially the researcher's level (1,560,000 -> 1,550,000); the small move is arithmetic housekeeping after real_cost changed, not a disagreement. Anchor A (diesel, wrong engine size): 2021-registered xDrive25d 旗艦版 at 158.8萬/59,000 km and 豪華版 at 143.0萬/60,000 km; against the verified 305萬 list for the 2019/8 xDrive25d 旗艦版 that is ~52% dealer retail at 59,000 km. Anchor B (six-cylinder, the closer mechanical analogue to a 3.0 diesel): 2021-registered xDrive40i 旗艦版 at 168.0萬/92,000 km and 158.8萬/140,000 km, ~41% of an estimated ~408萬 list. Applying that gradient lifts anchor A to ~57% and anchor B to ~49%; the two disagree materially, mostly because anchor A's 305萬 denominator is a 2019 figure applied to a 2021 car and is therefore probably too low. The 3-to-5 window is the steepest single stretch of the curve, and the mechanism is real rather than an artefact: the 3-year 原廠保固 expires inside it and the Taiwanese market applies a discrete out-of-warranty discount at that boundary, visible in the raw asks (age-3 30d 243萬, age-4 40i 210萬, age-5 comps 136.8-168萬).

But Taiwan dropped the xDrive30d after the 2019 first wave in favour of the xDrive25d, so NO 7-year-old 30d is on the market and the comps are the six-cylinder petrol 40i plus the 4-cylinder 25d. EXTRAPOLATED FROM THE PREDECESSOR GENERATION, as the batch rules require — the current G05 is only ~8 years old in Taiwan, so no genuine 10-year current-generation data exists and none was invented. Method: take real 10-year-old F15 (2014-2018) asking prices, express them as a retention ratio of that car's original list, then apply the ratio to this car's real_cost. Predecessor comps at 2016 registration, exactly 10 years old, confirmed in my own re-analysis of the cached crawl: 'X5 2016款 xDrive30d 3.0L' — the SAME 3.0 six-cylinder diesel — at 車商售價 72.8萬/130,000 km; xDrive25d 65.8萬/97,000 km; xDrive35i 65.0萬/100,000 km. NOTE ON BASIS: the ratio is applied to real_cost (3,445,000) rather than to list, per the batch rule for predecessor extrapolation. 3,445,000 * 0.25 = ~861,000 dealer RETAIL -> private_sale_price 14% below = 740,000; dealer_tradein_price a further 14.5% below = 630,000. maintenance.plan_notes:
TOTAL RAISED FROM 740,000 TO 858,000 (~85,800/year, ~NT$12.3/km). The researcher's 740,000 was too low for this car's class, for two specific reasons corrected below. The corrected total sits just under the Mercedes GLE 300 d 4MATIC's 941,000 in this same batch — the direct segment rival, a 343萬 German diesel SUV — and well above the BMW X3's 462,000, which is a defensible ordering for a 354萬 six-cylinder diesel on staggered 20-inch wheels. 汎德's parts and labour are not cheaper than 台灣賓士's, so a 21% gap under the GLE was not justifiable.

CORRECTION 1 — DO NOT ASSUME FREE SCHEDULED SERVICING. The researcher priced years 0-3 at almost nothing (8,000 and 12,000) on the basis that BSI (BMW Service Inclusive) 3年/6萬公里 is 'routinely bundled as a purchase incentive'. That claim was sourced only to a Yahoo search-results URL, and the sibling BMW record in this same batch reached the opposite conclusion from a direct dealer-page fetch: BMW Taiwan bundles NO complimentary scheduled maintenance, and BSI is a paid option that appears in some promotions and not others. bmw.com.tw timed out for me too, so I could not settle it either way — but an unverified assumption that zeroes out three years of servicing is the wrong default. Years 1 and 3 are therefore priced at REAL out-of-pocket cost. If a given deal does include a bundled BSI package, those two windows fall back to roughly 8,000 and 12,000 and the ten-year total drops by about 36,000 — a small effect on the whole, which is itself the point: this correction changes little, so the optimistic assumption was not worth making. What IS well established and retained: 原廠保固 3年不限里程 (extended from 2 years on 2024-06-01), so years 0-3 carry no repair exposure, only consumables and scheduled labour.

CORRECTION 2 — TYRE SPEC AND COST. The researcher's source string quoted the fitment as '275/45R20 315/35R20'. The rear size is wrong: U-CAR's spec page, re-fetched directly this round (HTTP 200), gives 輪胎尺寸 275/45 R20 front and 後輪尺寸 305/40 R20 rear for the xDrive30d; 315/35 R21 is the 21-inch fitment on the petrol xDrive40i. A 305/40 R20 rear is an expensive, low-volume size, and the M Sport staggered set cannot be rotated, so all four wear together and are replaced together. Set cost raised from 70,000 to 80,000 (year 5) and 85,000 (year 10) fitted, balanced and aligned. There is also unresolved risk that BMW's runflat (RSC) fitment applies here, which would add roughly 25-30% on top; that is NOT priced in, so the tyre lines are if anything still conservative.

CORRECTION 3 — MONOTONICITY. The researcher's year-7 window (145,000) came in BELOW year 5 (155,000), which is the wrong shape for a car that is out of warranty and ageing. The 5-7 window is where the ZF 8HP transmission service, rear brake discs, suspension bushings and the first real 48V ISG exposure all land. Raised to 178,000, so the schedule now rises monotonically across every window.

TIME-DRIVEN, NOT MILEAGE-DRIVEN. At 7,000 km/year this car never reaches BMW's CBS oil-interval mileage trigger before the 12-month clock expires, so it takes roughly ONE service per year — about ten visits and ~70,000 km across ten years — and the whole schedule is governed by time and component ageing rather than distance. Tyres are therefore replaced on AGE not tread (first set at year 5, second in the 7-10 window), the 12V AGM battery goes at year 5 and again in the 7-10 window (Taiwan's heat is hard on batteries), and brake fluid goes every 2 years throughout. Front pads land around 35,000-49,000 km given the car's 2,220 kg. No spark plugs — this is a diesel — but a fuel filter is added to every service instead.

WHY THIS IS MUCH MORE EXPENSIVE THAN A JAPANESE SUV. Roughly 858,000 over ten years against maybe 200,000-250,000 for a RAV4, and against 414,000 for the Toyota Land Cruiser diesel in this same batch. Four structural reasons: (1) BMW dealer labour rates and genuine-parts pricing — a routine annual service on a six-cylinder diesel runs 13,000-17,000 against 5,000-12,000 for smaller BMWs; (2) staggered 20-inch wheels on a 2.2-tonne SUV, so a set of four premium tyres plus fitting is 80,000-85,000 and the brakes are correspondingly large; (3) known German age-failure items concentrated at 8-10 years — electric water pump, thermostat housing, valve-cover and oil-pan gasket seepage, electronic damper failure; (4) diesel-specific and 48V-specific risk.

THE DIESEL / LOW-MILEAGE TRAP. This buyer's profile is the WORST case for a DPF: 7,000 km/year of short, cold, low-speed urban trips is precisely the pattern that prevents passive regeneration and clogs the filter. DPF cleaning is ~15,000, replacement well over 100,000, so the year-10 window carries a probability-weighted 35,000 for it plus 20,000 for EGR/intake carbon cleaning. The 48V ISG starter-generator and its lithium battery are separate out-of-warranty risk parts, weighted into years 7 and 10.

All figures are informed estimates built from Taiwanese service-price ranges and parts pricing, not from a published official BMW Taiwan service-price table — one was sought and could not be reached. Treat them as planning numbers, not quotes.

Two sibling records in the same dataset drove corrections here: the BMW X3 20 xDrive xLine record (documents a PTT 菜單 showing ~12% off list on a G45 X3, and a direct dealer-page finding that BMW Taiwan bundles no free scheduled servicing) and the Mercedes GLE 300 d 4MATIC record (the direct 343萬 German diesel-SUV rival, carrying a 150,000 discount, 70.6%/59.4%/47.1%/36.8%/22.4% retention and a 941,000 ten-year maintenance total). Those two calibrate the discount and the maintenance total in this record.

assumptions.notes: 以 7,000 km/年為中值推算各檢查點里程（7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km），遠低於台灣平均 12,000-15,000 km/年。此里程下保養由「時間」而非「里程」驅動：BMW CBS 機油保養每年一次會先到期，煞車油每 2 年一次，輪胎因橡膠老化（約 5-6 年）而非磨耗到底而更換。動力歸類為 gasoline：U-CAR 車款頁確認本車為 B58 3.0 直列 6 缸渦輪 381hp，搭配整合於變速箱的 ISG 48V 輕油電（急加速時額外輸出 9kW/12hp、20.4kgm），無法純電行駛，故不是 hybrid；Yahoo 汽車資料庫將其標為「油電混合」屬分類誤植，本表不採用。稅金與保險（燃料稅 7,200 元/年、牌照稅 15,210 元/年、車體險）依設計一律排除，不計入本表任何欄位。保養金額假設全程回原廠（汎德授權服務廠）施作；改用專業外廠可下降約 30-40%，但會影響原廠保養紀錄與中古車行情。

purchase.source: 建議售價 399 萬元經兩個獨立來源在本次覆核中重新抓取確認：U-CAR 新車頻道 X5 車款頁（規格表列 xDrive40i M Sport鉑金版 399 萬、xDrive30d M Sport鉑金版 354 萬，內文載明「2026 年 4 月發表新年式 BMW X5 與 X6 鉑金版…售價分別為 354 萬元（較原先 xDrive30d xLine 車型漲 9 萬元）和 399 萬元（漲 7 萬元）」），以及 Yahoo 汽車 2026 X5 車款總覽頁（共 2 筆車型，354 - 399 萬）。原研究者的 3,990,000 正確，未修正。折扣依 8891 新車頻道彙整之汎德 2026 年 7 月官方優惠原文推算：X5、X6 為「月付9900元起or120萬48期0利率 ◎贈1年乙式險(指定年式車型)」，明確不在 X3／5 系列 Sedan／7 系列／X7 的 180 萬 0 利率級距，也不在 iX2（4 年不限里程保養套裝）與 X1／X2（3 年/4 萬公里保養套裝）的免費保養名單內。
purchase.notes: list_price 3,990,000 為 2026 年 4 月發表之新年式「鉑金版」建議售價（前一新年式 xDrive40i M Sport 為 392 萬，鉑金版加入 BMW 飾光水箱護罩、雙前座通風／舒適型座椅後調漲 7 萬）。discounts 160,000（約 4.0%）的理由：X5 在汎德的促銷梯隊屬中段，現金買家可把 120 萬 48 期 0 利率的利息補貼（約 8-9 萬）加上首年乙式險（399 萬車體險約 5-7 萬）折算成空車現金折讓——8891 該文亦自述這些補貼「若打算全額現金一次付清，通常能轉換為極度深度的隱藏空車折扣」——實務上約 13-16 萬；鉑金版 2026 年 4 月才上市、產品週期僅 4 個月會壓縮折讓空間，故取 16 萬而非上限。註：2026 年 8 月的「BMW 仲夏禮遇」為全車系贈晶華酒店三天兩夜套裝（價值逾 3 萬），屬非現金贈品，未計入 discounts。onroad_fees 95,000 = 領牌與監理規費約 1,000＋代辦費約 9,000＋配件約 85,000（隔熱紙、行車紀錄器、原廠踏板／防水托盤／行李廂墊、鍍膜），此級距配件包實務落在 8-12 萬。動力為 B58 直六渦輪＋整合於變速箱的 ISG 48V 輕油電，無法純電行駛，故歸類 gasoline 而非 hybrid。稅金與保險已排除。real_cost = 3,990,000 - 160,000 + 95,000 = 3,925,000。

items.name: 過戶費（含代辦與監理規費）
售前整備與內外美容（含拋光、內裝清潔、引擎室整理）
刊登費（8891 個人自售刊登＋精選曝光）

selling_costs.notes: 取此級距區間（6,000-15,000）的偏上緣。399 萬級距的德系豪華 SUV 若要達成 private_sale_price，售前整備與美容不能省——買家會逐項檢視鈑件、內裝與引擎室；整備不足通常直接反映為 3-5 萬的殺價空間，遠大於這筆 8,000 元。刊登費以 8891 個人自售加精選曝光計。

value_checkpoints.source: 本次覆核自行重抓 8891 中古車「X5 xDrive40i」在售車源（2026-08-12，共 63 筆去重，含年份／里程／車商售價）。1 年車（2025 年出廠、LCI xDrive40i M Sport，當時牌價 392 萬）實測 6 筆：328.0 萬@3,166km、328.0 萬@3,224km、325.0 萬@3,000km、319.0 萬@6,000km、308.0 萬@9,000km（另 1 筆@3,317km 電洽）。本買家 7,000 km 正好落在樣本區間內，無需外插：以 319.0萬@6,000km 與 308.0萬@9,000km 直接內插，車商開價約 316 萬（45 筆母體的 age+km 對數迴歸給 327 萬，但同齡樣本內插更可靠，因近新車對里程極度敏感——3,000km 到 9,000km 就掉 20 萬）。修正原研究者的兩個錯誤：(1) 他取的「中位數 325 萬」對應的是 3,000km 車而非買家的 7,000km；(2) 他只對車商開價下修 9.2%，低於 8-15% 區間，且未考慮這批低里程車源多為汎德 BPS 原廠認證中古車（含延長保固，開價本就含認證溢價），個人自售無法比照。改以車商開價 -13% 得自售價：316 萬×(399/392)×0.87 ≈ 282 萬，取 2,820,000（= real_cost 的 71.8%）。車商收購價再低 12% 得 2,480,000（車商買 248 萬、賣 316-322 萬，毛利約 27%，符合台灣豪華中古車行實務）。

同一份 2026-08-12 自抓的 8891 車源。3 年車（2023 年出廠、LCI xDrive40i M Sport、牌價 392 萬）僅 2 筆：288.8 萬@4,900km、275.0 萬@18,000km，且兩筆皆為高雄汎德 BPS 原廠認證中古車，帶認證溢價。單靠這 2 筆內插會得到 272 萬（偏高），故改以 45 筆全樣本的對數迴歸（每年 -10.1%、每萬公里 -2.9%、殘差 sd 6.5%）在 3 年/21,000km 處給 254 萬，兩者取偏迴歸的折衷值 262 萬作為車商開價（= 牌價 66.8%）。自售價 = 車商開價 -13%（同樣因樣本含 BPS 認證溢價而取區間中段）得牌價的 58.1%，套用至本車 399 萬牌價得 2,320,000（= real_cost 的 59.1%）。車商收購價再低 12.5% 得 2,030,000。confidence 由原研究者的 high 下修為 medium：同齡樣本只有 2 筆，且兩筆同屬一家認證體系，不足以支撐 high。

同一份 2026-08-12 自抓的 8891 車源。5 年車（2021 年出廠、小改款前 xDrive40i 旗艦版、牌價 377 萬）實測 168.0 萬@92,000km、158.8 萬@140,000km（另 1 筆@51,000km 電洽）；鄰近年份 2022 年 210.0 萬@64,000km、166.8 萬@100,000km，2020 年 148.8 萬@70,000km、151.8 萬@79,300km。全部樣本里程都遠高於本買家的 35,000 km，必須向低里程外插，故以 45 筆全樣本的對數迴歸（每年 -10.1%、每萬公里 -2.9%）在 5 年/35,000km 處求值得車商開價 197 萬，再與三組跨年份手算交叉檢核（由 2021 年 168萬@92,000km 回推約 194 萬、由 2020 年 150萬@70,000km 回推約 179 萬、由 2019 年 159萬@60,800km 回推約 191 萬）後取 195 萬（= 牌價 51.7%）。修正原研究者的 208 萬：該值幾乎等於實測的 4 年車 210萬@64,000km，等於說 5 年車與 4 年車同價，不合理；且他用的「每萬公里 3.5%」百分比係數在 57,000 km 的大幅外插下會系統性高估。自售價 = 車商開價 -13% 得牌價 45.0%，套用至 399 萬得 1,800,000（= real_cost 的 45.9%）。車商收購價再低 13% 得 1,570,000。confidence medium：同齡樣本真實但僅 2 筆有價，且需大幅低里程外插。

同一份 2026-08-12 自抓的 8891 車源，7 年車（2019 年出廠、小改款前 G05 xDrive40i，豪華版牌價 343 萬／旗艦版 373 萬）是全表樣本最充足的一組，共 24 筆：最低里程有價者 159.0 萬@60,800km、148.0 萬@63,000km、155.8 萬@71,000km（M Sport）、139.8 萬@75,000km、140.0 萬@93,000km、137.0 萬@93,300km、128.0／126.0 萬@100,000km、122.8 萬@139,000km、99.0 萬@150,000km；另有數筆 15,000-35,000km 的 2019 年車標「電洽」未揭價。本買家 49,000 km 低於所有揭價樣本，以 45 筆全樣本對數迴歸在 7 年/49,000km 處得車商開價 152 萬，與由 159.0萬@60,800km 手動回推的 164 萬取折衷得 156 萬（= 旗艦版牌價 373 萬的 41.8%）。原研究者取 170 萬偏高，主因是他只用了 cohort 內開價最高的幾筆、且未處理樣本中混有牌價較低的豪華版。自售價 = 車商開價 -14%（車齡越大車商議價空間越寬）得牌價 35.9%，套用至 399 萬得 1,430,000（= real_cost 的 36.4%）。車商收購價再低 14% 得 1,230,000。此時已過 3 年原廠保固 4 年，中古市場明確把保外維修風險計入價格，故續跌而非打平。confidence medium：樣本量最充足，但仍須外插至低於觀測里程下緣。

外插，非實測：現行 G05 世代 2018 年 12 月才在台上市（至今 7.7 年），沒有真實的 10 年車價可用，因此依規則改用前代 F15 的實際行情換算保留率再套回本車。本次覆核自抓 8891「BMW X5」全車系車源（2026-08-12，148 筆去重）確認 F15 的 10 年車實價：2016 年出廠 xDrive35i（3.0 直六汽油）65.0 萬@100,000km；同年份 xDrive25d 群組 65.8萬@97,000km、58.8萬@110,000km、55.0萬@116,400km、58.8萬@118,700km、53.8萬@150,000km、59.8萬@160,000km、48.0萬@168,000km，由此得 10 年車的里程係數約每 1,000 km 0.15 萬（遠比新車平緩）。將 65.0萬@100,000km 外插至 70,000 km（+30,000km）得車商開價約 70 萬，佔 F15 xDrive35i 原始牌價 332 萬的 21.1%。自售價 = 車商開價 -15%（10 年德系 SUV 車商接手意願低、議價空間最寬）得原始牌價的 17.9%，套用至本車 399 萬牌價得 715,000，取 720,000（= real_cost 的 18.3%）。車商收購價再低 16% 得 600,000。confidence low：世代不同、引擎不同（N55 vs B58），且 G05 LCI 的曲面螢幕、iDrive 8.5 與 48V ISG 電子複雜度遠高於 F15，保外風險溢價可能更重，18.3% 甚至可能仍偏樂觀；另 F15 的 332 萬原始牌價係沿用原研究者提供的 Yahoo 2016 資料庫數字，本次未能重新驗證。

maintenance.plan_notes: 金額為回原廠（汎德授權服務廠）施作的估算，每期為「距上一檢查點之累計支出」，非累計總額。10 年合計約 1,002,000 元（約 14.3 元/km）——這是本次覆核改動最大的部分：原研究者估 639,000，低於本表中定價更低的 Mercedes GLE300d（牌價 343 萬、10 年 941,000）與 Porsche Cayenne 3.0T（牌價 419 萬、10 年 1,044,000），對一台 399 萬的德系豪華 SUV 不合理，且其第 5-7 年（134,000）竟低於第 3-5 年（143,000），與車齡增長的支出曲線相反。修正後 1,002,000 恰落在 GLE300d 與 Cayenne 之間，與售價位階一致。保固與套餐現況：汎德提供新車 3 年不限里程原廠保固；關鍵是依 8891 彙整的汎德 2026 年 7 月官方優惠原文，免費保養套裝只給 iX2（4 年不限里程）與 X1／X2（3 年/4 萬公里），X5／X6 只有「月付9900元起or120萬48期0利率＋贈1年乙式險」，因此本車自第 1 年起所有定保費用都由車主自付，第 1、3 期並未被套餐補貼；第 3 年保固到期後（第 5、7、10 期）更是完全無補貼的全額自費，這是曲線在第 5 期起大幅墊高的原因。（註：2026 年 8 月「仲夏禮遇」新聞提到指定車款可於「一年乙式全險或原廠保養套裝」二擇一，但該報導未列出車系明細，7 月版是目前唯一有車系解析度的來源，故仍依 7 月版假設 X5 無保養套裝；若實際購車時 X5 拿得到保養套裝，第 1、3 期可各減約 1-3 萬。）保養節奏由時間而非里程決定：7,000 km/年下 CBS 的機油保養每年一次會先到期，煞車油每 2 年一次，輪胎因老化而非磨耗更換。輪胎為 20 吋 M Sport 輪圈搭失壓續跑胎（RFT），M Sport 常見為前 275/45R20、後 305/40R20 的前後配（部分車型為四輪同規）；前後尺寸不同無法對調輪胎位置、只能整組更換，單組連工帶定位約 7.2-7.6 萬——這是與日系同級最大的單項差距。第 5 期與第 10 期各含一組輪胎（約每 5 年一組）。後期風險項目已具體提列：B58 電子水泵浦與節溫器總成、點火線圈組、曲軸箱通風閥（PCV）與氣門室蓋／機油濾清器座墊片滲油、M 電子可變阻尼避震器與懸吊連桿襯套、以及保外的 48V ISG 啟動發電機／48V 鋰電池（本車 LCI 特有，非傳統燃油車項目）。懸吊採 M 跑車化電子懸吊（可變阻尼，U-CAR 車款頁確認為 M Sport 套件標配），氣壓懸吊在台灣為選配、本規格未標配，故未提列氣壓避震器總成更換；若該車選配了氣壓懸吊，第 10 期應再增加約 8-12 萬。約為同期 Toyota RAV4 的 4 倍以上，差距來自原廠工資、大尺寸煞車與 RFT 輪胎、以及保外風險項目。若改用專業外廠可再降約 30-40%，但會犧牲原廠保養紀錄，進而壓低前述中古行情。

checkpoints.source: 台灣 BMW 車主原廠定保費用經驗區間：原廠僅做最基礎保養（機油、機油芯、基本檢查）單次約 5,000-6,000 元；若不刪除原廠預設加項（各式添加劑、冷氣風箱清潔等），常規保養落在 8,500-9,500 元。X5 搭載 B58 直六、機油量約 7L，且 X5 為大型 SUV、原廠工資級距高於 3／X3 系列，故取 16,000 元（原研究者取 12,000，低於本表同級的 Mercedes GLE300d 18,000 與 Porsche Cayenne 16,000，對 399 萬車不合理）。保固期內故障維修免費，但定保不含在內（X5 不在汎德贈送保養套裝的車系名單）。註：費用區間來自二手彙整內容（UpToGo），該站有 Cloudflare 防護，本次與原研究者均未能讀取全文，僅取搜尋摘要。

checkpoints.source: 輪胎：G05 X5 M Sport 為 20 吋 RFT，M Sport 常見前 275/45R20＋後 305/40R20 前後配，市售同規 RFT 單條約 15,000-20,000，整組 4 條含安裝定位取 72,000。煞車來令片：Mobile01 車主報價顯示外廠前後來令片＋感應線＋工資約 8,000，原廠件另有「前來令片報價破萬」的討論；X5 煞車尺寸大且為原廠件，前後含感應線取 36,000。火星塞 6 支含工資 16,000。機油保養 2 次 32,000、煞車油 5,000、冷卻液 7,000、濾網類 8,000。合計 176,000（原研究者 143,000）。註：Mobile01 對程式化擷取回應 403，本次與原研究者均未能讀取全文。

checkpoints.source: 外插提列，非單一報價：本期車齡 7-10 年、已保外 4-7 年，是 BMW 保外支出最集中的區間。輪胎第 2 組 76,000；機油保養 3 次 54,000；點火線圈 6 支＋第 2 次火星塞 42,000；M 跑車化電子懸吊（可變阻尼）避震器總成與懸吊連桿／襯套整理 135,000——這是本期最大單項，2.2 噸 SUV 的電子阻尼避震器單支原廠價高且 10 年幾乎必換，原研究者僅列 55,000 明顯偏低；48V ISG 啟動發電機與 48V 鋰電池為本車 LCI 才有的機構，保外更換單價高，風險提列 55,000；PCV 與其餘滲油點 32,000；iDrive 8.5／曲面螢幕、控制模組與感知器類電子故障提列 45,000（G05 LCI 電子含量遠高於前代，這類故障在保外期是實質支出）；冷氣壓縮機、水箱與傳動系統風險提列 48,000；煞車油 ×2、冷卻液、濾網類 31,000。合計 518,000，與本表 GLE300d 的 505,000、Cayenne 的 527,000 同級。confidence low：這些是機率性支出的期望值，個別車輛可能完全沒發生，也可能單一項目就超出本期估算；若該車選配氣壓懸吊，本期應再增加約 8-12 萬。

assumptions.notes: Owner drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, roughly half the Taiwan average. Every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000 km). At this rate BMW's Condition Based Service clock is TIME-driven, not mileage-driven: the annual engine-oil service, the 2-yearly brake fluid and the 5-6 year tire age-out all fall due long before the mileage triggers, so maintenance barely scales down with the low mileage. Licence tax (牌照稅 15,210/yr for the 2,998 c.c. 2401-3000 bracket) and fuel tax (燃料稅 7,200/yr) are EXCLUDED by design, as is insurance. Full-body PPF (犀牛皮 — real PTT quotes on this exact car run 90,000-120,000) is an optional cosmetic purchase and is excluded from onroad_fees. Market caveat as of Aug 2026: the X6 is US-built (U-CAR spec sheet gives 產地 美國), so the unresolved US-tariff / 貨物稅 question is directly relevant — PTT threads show it simultaneously inflating new-car cash discounts and freezing buyers, which softens used BMW residuals. Both effects are reflected. FACT-CHECK NOTE: this record was rebuilt after adversarial review. The list price, the powertrain call and every used listing quoted by the original researcher were independently re-verified and found correct; the value curve and the maintenance schedule were both corrected upward/downward against the BMW X5 xDrive40i M Sport — the X6's mechanical twin (same B58, same 48V ISG, same ZF 8HP, same 汎德 dealer network) — which is priced in the same dataset.

purchase.source: List price INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED and CONFIRMED at NT$4,060,000. (1) U-CAR's X6 model page header reads '2 車型 406 - 565 萬', and its news text states '新年式 X6 則是提供 xDrive40i M Sport 鉑金版，售價為 406 萬元 (漲 7 萬元)，搭配原有的 M60i xDrive 車型' (https://newcar.u-car.com.tw/bmw/x6/7171/overall). (2) Yahoo 汽車機車's 2026 X6 page independently lists xDrive40i M Sport 鉑金版 at 406萬, 2998cc, 381hp (https://autos.yahoo.com.tw/new-cars/model/bmw-x6-2026). Note the original researcher's paraphrase said the 406萬 鉑金版 is the 'single' trim — U-CAR actually says it is offered alongside the existing M60i xDrive at 565萬. Price figure unaffected. Discount from real, verified PTT transaction reports rather than a guess: the buyer thread https://www.ptt.cc/bbs/car/M.1754661956.A.6A2.html states verbatim '台中報價從四月折扣15萬 七月折扣20萬 八月現在折扣25萬' on the 399萬 car, with another poster computing '牌價399,折30=369'; the follow-up https://www.ptt.cc/bbs/car/M.1757687711.A.13B.html gives dealer quotes of 台北 -29萬 / 新北 -28萬 / 桃園 -24萬 / 台中 -24萬. 280,000 (6.9%) is a realistic mid-market cash discount on the fresher 406萬 car — higher than the X5's because the X6 is the slower-selling niche body style.
purchase.notes: POWERTRAIN: this car carries BMW's ISG (Integrated Starter-Generator) 48V mild-hybrid system integrated with the gearbox, feeding the B58 3.0L straight-six turbo (381 hp @ 5200-6250 rpm, 53 kgm). U-CAR's spec table lists 動力系統 '48V輕油電混合' but 能源 '汽油', and the 48V lithium pack is only 0.44 kWh — it cannot move the car on battery alone. Several TW used listings (and Yahoo 汽車機車's own 2026 page, and a live SUM listing for a 2022 X6) mislabel it '油電車' / 'Hybrid'; that is a trap. Correctly classified as gasoline. onroad_fees = 85,000: 領牌+驗車+代辦 ~15,000, plus a realistic accessory pack for a 400萬-class SUV ~70,000 (全車隔熱紙 with panoramic roof ~35,000, 行車紀錄器前後 ~15,000, 腳踏墊/行李廂墊/門檻 ~12,000, 鍍膜 ~8,000). This accessory spend is consistent with the PTT buyer who explicitly declined the dealer's free-accessory package ('配件全折 我都不要') and therefore bought his own. Excludes optional 犀牛皮 full-body PPF. Tax and insurance excluded per spec. real_cost = 4,060,000 - 280,000 + 85,000 = 3,865,000. Generation context: this is the G06, on sale in TW since Dec 2019 (launch prices 365萬 / 380萬 首發版 / 560萬 M50i per U-CAR's 事件簿) and facelifted in 2023 — a late-cycle car with a successor widely expected around 2028-2029, which is priced into the residual curve. A PTT poster in the buyer thread makes the same point: 'X6可能是這一代最後一年了'.

value_checkpoints.source: EXTRAPOLATED — no 1-year-old G06 X6 exists on the TW used market yet; the newest genuine listings found across HOT 好車大聯盟 and SUM are 2023 cars. REVISED DOWN from an earlier estimate of 2,880,000. Two anchors: (a) the achievable NET new price is ~3,780,000 (406萬 less the ~28萬 cash discount PTT buyers actually get), and (b) the year-3 anchor below. Implied dealer retail asking for a 1-year-old, 7,000 km car is ~3,070,000; private sale sits ~11% under dealer retail = 2,720,000; dealer trade-in a further ~13% under private = 2,360,000. That is a 29.6% first-year loss against real_cost — deliberately steeper than a Japanese equivalent, because a buyer can get a brand-new one with the full 3-year warranty for only about 1,150,000 more. Cross-checked against the BMW X5 xDrive40i M Sport in this same dataset (the X6's mechanical twin), which retains 71.8% of real_cost at year 1; the X6 is set slightly BELOW it at 70.4% because the coupe-SUV body has a materially thinner buyer pool in Taiwan. The 2026 tariff-cut speculation freezing the market makes a soft year-1 residual more likely, not less.

Anchored on real listings I pulled directly from HOT 好車大聯盟's filtered inventory API (brand=BMW, carType=X6 XDRIVE40I) and verified line by line: a 2023 X6 xDrive40i with 30,551 km at 車商售價 2,688,000. A second 2023/24 car at 3,580,000 (47,680 km) exists but is heavily accessorised ('全車精品改ID8') and still under factory warranty, so it is treated as an upper outlier rather than discarded silently — note it pulls the true market ABOVE the single low anchor, and the spread between the two 2023 cars (892,000) is the main reason this is medium and not high confidence. Our buyer is at 21,000 km, below the 30,551 km anchor, so dealer retail is nudged to ~2,710,000. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN APPLIED: these are 車商售價 (dealer RETAIL asking), never copied straight across — private sale ≈ 12% below dealer asking = 2,380,000; dealer trade-in ≈ 13.4% below private = 2,060,000. Cross-check cluster of 2022 cars (4 years old) from the same API: 2,038,000 @ 102,995 km, 2,080,000 @ 108,452 km, 2,090,000 @ 100,000 km, 2,090,000 @ 100,080 km, 2,180,000 @ 66,217 km, 2,350,000 @ 90,204 km, plus SUM 汽車網 showing a 2022 X6 G06 鉑金版 at 245.8萬.

Real 5-year-old cluster pulled from HOT 好車大聯盟's filtered API and individually verified: three 2021 X6 xDrive40i M Sport at 46,869 / 49,624 / 50,000 km asking 2,268,000 / 2,288,000 / 2,280,000 車商售價 (mean 2,278,667), plus a fourth 2021 M Sport on SUM 汽車網 at 188萬 which pulls the four-car mean down to ~2,179,000. Our buyer is at 35,000 km, under the ~48,800 km of the listed trio, so a modest low-mileage premium of ~+4% gives dealer retail ~2,265,000. ADJUSTMENT CHAIN: private sale ≈ 15% under dealer asking = 1,920,000; dealer trade-in ≈ 14% under private = 1,650,000. The 15% (rather than 11%) private haircut and the resulting 49.7% retention are deliberately at the conservative end of the 8-15% band: by 2031 the G06 will have been replaced, and a superseded niche German shape drops faster than its SUV sibling. NOTE — the earlier version of this record quoted the 2021 X6's list price as 392萬; that figure is actually the 2023 LCI X5 xDrive40i M Sport's price per U-CAR's 事件簿 ('X5提供345萬xDrive30d xLine、392萬xDrive40i M Sport雙車型；X6則為399萬'). The 2021 X6 xDrive40i M Sport 鉑金版 listed at 398萬, so the observed retention is ~57% of list, not 58%.

EXTRAPOLATED from the PREDECESSOR generation, because the G06 (TW launch Dec 2019) has no genuine 7-year data and none was fabricated. The F16 X6 xDrive35i's TW list price of 3,680,000 was independently re-verified on Yahoo 汽車機車's 2015 X6 page (xDrive30d 368萬, xDrive35i 368萬 / 2979cc / 306hp, M50d 542萬, xDrive50i 590萬, M 658萬). Real F16 xDrive35i listings today, pulled from HOT: a 2018 car (age 8) at 104,566 km asking 1,130,000 = 30.7% retention; 2017 cars (age 9) at 111,737 / 140,000 / 148,000 km asking 838,000 / 898,000 / 888,000 = 22.8-24.4%. Taking the age-8 30.7% ratio, correcting +8% for being a year younger and +18% for roughly half the mileage (49,000 vs 104,566 km) gives ~39% retention. Applied to this car's real_cost per instruction: 0.39 x 3,865,000 = ~1,507,000 dealer retail asking. CHAIN: private sale ≈ 12% under = 1,330,000; dealer trade-in ≈ 14% under private = 1,140,000. The +18% mileage premium is deliberately milder than the +25% used in the earlier draft — at seven years the value of a German SUV is set by out-of-warranty repair risk and thin demand more than by the odometer. Cross-check: the oldest G06 cars (2020, age 6) sit at 1,758,000 (150,716 km, HOT) and 192.8萬 (SUM), consistent with a 7-year low-mileage car asking ~1,500,000. The tail keeps falling rather than flattening — the 3-year warranty is long gone and the market prices in B58 electric-water-pump and 48V-ISG exposure.

maintenance.plan_notes: REVISED UPWARD after fact-check. The earlier version of this record totalled 668,000 over ten years (~17.3% of real_cost). That is not a German number: the BMW X5 xDrive40i M Sport — this car's mechanical twin, sharing the B58 straight-six, the 48V ISG, the ZF 8HP gearbox and the 汎德 dealer network — carries 1,002,000 (25.5% of real_cost) in the same dataset, and every other large German SUV/saloon priced here sits in a 22-28% band (Porsche Cayenne 24.6%, Mercedes GLE450 22.2%, GLE300d 27.7%, BMW 735i 24.7%). The X6 should be at or ABOVE its X5 twin, not a third below it, because it runs staggered 21-inch rubber (275/40 R21 front, 315/35 R21 rear per U-CAR's spec table) against the X5's 20-inch fitment, on a 2,165 kg body. Corrected total is 1,074,000 (27.8% of real_cost, ~NT$15.3/km at this low mileage) — roughly triple a comparable Japanese SUV, which is the honest picture. WHY THE EARLIER FIGURE WAS TOO LOW: it zeroed out years 0-3 on the strength of a 3年/4萬公里原廠保養套餐. That package is real and verified — the PTT buyer of this exact model states '送前三年保養套餐' and '只留3年/4萬保養套餐' — but it is a NEGOTIATED dealer sweetener taken in lieu of free accessories ('配件全折 我都不要'), on the outgoing 399萬 car, in a specific month. It is not standard equipment on the 406萬 鉑金版, and the X5 twin in this dataset does not model one. Base case here therefore carries the normal scheduled-service cost in years 0-3, with the 3年不限里程原廠保固 still covering failures. SENSITIVITY: a buyer who successfully negotiates the package instead of accessories cuts years 0-3 from 64,000 to roughly 27,000 — but should then also expect a smaller cash discount. INTERVALS ARE TIME-DRIVEN: at 7,000 km/year the annual oil service, the 2-yearly brake fluid and the 5-6 year tire age-out all trigger on the calendar long before any mileage threshold, which is why the bill barely scales down with the low mileage. Cost drivers specific to this car: staggered 21-inch OE run-flat rubber (a Michelin PS4 SUV 315/35R21 alone is quoted at NT$12,132 完工價 on Yahoo 拍賣, and the OE Pirelli P Zero run-flat fitment is dearer still, so a staggered set with alignment lands near 75,000); oversized brake discs on a 2,165 kg SUV; a ZF 8-speed whose fluid-and-pan service plus transfer case and diff oils runs ~35,000; the late-life B58 risk list (electric water pump plus thermostat, coil packs, valve-cover/PCV oil weeping); and the 48V ISG starter-generator and its 0.44 kWh lithium pack — a mild-hybrid-specific exposure a naturally-aspirated Japanese SUV simply does not have.

assumptions.notes: Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, far below the Taiwan average of ~12,000-15,000 km/year. Every checkpoint uses assumed_km = 7000 * years (7,000 / 21,000 / 35,000 / 49,000 / 70,000). At this mileage BMW's Condition Based Service mileage triggers are essentially never reached, so servicing is TIME-driven (annual oil service, 2-year brake fluid, ~4-year plugs, 5-6 year tires) rather than mileage-driven, which raises cost-per-km sharply versus an average-mileage owner. Tax and insurance are excluded from every figure by design: for reference only, this 2,998 c.c. car carries NT$15,210 牌照稅 + NT$7,200 燃料費 = NT$22,410/year (correct Taiwan brackets for 2,401-3,000 c.c.). That burden is NOT counted here but is a real drag on demand for older 3.0L examples and is one reason the 7- and 10-year tail is priced low. No home-charger cost applies (combustion car). Fuel is also excluded. Tires are treated as an age-limited item, not a mileage item: 19-inch staggered run-flats age out around 5-6 years at 7,000 km/year long before they wear out. LIQUIDITY IS THE DOMINANT UNCERTAINTY: there is not one current-generation G29 Z4 listed for sale in Taiwan on any platform checked, so every value checkpoint is an extrapolation and is marked low confidence.

purchase.notes: POWERTRAIN: classified 'gasoline' — CORRECT and unchanged. The 3.0L B58 turbocharged inline-6 (2,998 c.c., 340 hp) is a conventional combustion engine with no plug and no electric-only drive, so it is 'gasoline' under this table's rules. NOTE ON THE 48V CLAIM: the researcher asserted as fact that the G29 Z4 M40i is 'not fitted with BMW's 48V starter-generator'. That rests only on the absence of a 48V/油電 notation in a TW spec table, which is absence of evidence rather than evidence of absence, and I could not verify it from any source I could reach this session. The classification is unaffected either way — a 48V mild hybrid is still 'gasoline' for this table, since it cannot move the car on battery alone. The only practical consequence is that IF a 48V ISG is fitted, the 7-10 year period should carry an additional starter-generator/48V-battery risk item; the wording has been softened accordingly and this is left as an open question. MODEL YEAR: the car on sale is the facelifted (LCI) G29 introduced locally in April 2023, when the M40i price was held at NT$3,720,000 while the sDrive20i rose NT$240,000 to NT$3,050,000. Recorded as model_year 2026 because the car is on sale in August 2026 at unchanged pricing and every other record in this batch (92/92) uses 2026 — NOT 'per instruction' as the researcher wrote, which misstated the brief. Note that Yahoo has no 2026 Z4 page (https://autos.yahoo.com.tw/new-cars/model/bmw-z4-2026 returns 404); the live TW page is still labelled 2025. Price is identical under either label, so this is a labelling choice with no financial effect. DISCOUNTS NT$180,000 (~4.8%): BMW Taiwan's importer 汎德 is disciplined on headline price, but the Z4 is a niche, slow-moving two-seat roadster at the end of a long generation, which is where TW BMW dealers have the most room. Blends a modest cash discount with accessory giveaways. Estimated negotiated outcome, not a published discount. ON-ROAD FEES NT$95,000 = 領牌/規費 + 代辦 (~NT$15,000) + the accessory pack normal at this price point (~NT$80,000: window film, dashcam, paint protection/coating, mats, trunk tray). Tax and insurance EXCLUDED. real_cost = 3,720,000 - 180,000 + 95,000 = 3,635,000.

value_checkpoints.source: ESTIMATE, not a listing — REVISED DOWN by the fact-check pass from NT$2,680,000. Verified finding (I re-ran these queries myself): there is not one current-generation G29 Z4 listed for sale anywhere in Taiwan. SUM 汽車網 (https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch/BMW/Z4?v=4) returns exactly 2 cars nationwide, both previous-generation E89 (2013 and 2011); HOT 大聯盟 (https://www.hotcar.com.tw/UsedCarSell/CarFilter) returns 無符合條件之車輛. So no year-1 transaction data exists. WHY REVISED: the researcher benchmarked off Porsche CPO cars asking 82-88% of list, then stated TWO downward adjustments (BMW retains worse than Porsche; the Z4's buyer pool is 'very thin') but landed on 82% — the bottom of the Porsche band, i.e. no net adjustment was actually applied. Cross-checked against comparable German records in this same dataset, their figure put the Z4 at 73.7% of real_cost, only 1.6pp below a Porsche Cayenne (75.3%) and ABOVE a BMW 7-Series (70.9%), despite the Z4 being the least liquid car in the set. Dealers bid defensively on inventory they cannot turn, and a private seller with zero comparable listings has no price anchor to negotiate against — both push year 1 down. Corrected: implied dealer RETAIL asking ~NT$2,900,000 (78% of list); private sale set ~11.7% below that asking price per the 車商售價 > 自售價 > 車商收購價 chain; dealer trade-in a further ~13.5% below private. Low mileage (7,000 km) is priced in as a premium over a mileage-blind average.

Low-mileage adjustment applied.

ESTIMATE by predecessor-generation extrapolation — no genuine 7-year data exists for the current G29 (TW launch May 2019, so the oldest cars are barely 7 years old and none are listed anywhere). Method, re-verified by the fact-check pass: the two real E89 listings on SUM (https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch/BMW/Z4?v=4) are a 2013 Z4 sDrive28i, 102,686 km, dealer asking NT$738,000 against a TW list of NT$3,090,000 = 23.9% retention at ~13 years, and a 2011 Z4 sDrive20i, 147,721 km, NT$588,000 against ~NT$2,720,000 = 21.6% at ~15 years. I independently re-fetched this page and both listings match the quoted year, mileage and price exactly. That decay curve was interpolated back to 7 years and applied to this car's list price. Implied dealer retail asking ~NT$1,400,000 (37.6% of list); private sale ~13.2% below asking, trade-in ~16.9% below private. No warranty, and the German tail keeps falling rather than flattening the way a Lexus would. Adjusted UP for the 49,000 km assumption versus the 100,000+ km E89 comparators. Revised down from NT$1,270,000 for curve consistency.

ESTIMATE by predecessor-generation extrapolation, as the brief prescribes — the G29 is only 7 years old in Taiwan so no genuine 10-year data can exist. Ratio source, independently re-verified: 2013 BMW Z4 sDrive28i, original TW list NT$3,090,000, currently listed at 102,686 km for NT$738,000 dealer asking at ~13 years = 23.9% of original list (https://www.sum.com.tw/carsearch/BMW/Z4?v=4). Adjusting that ratio for 10 years instead of 13 and for 70,000 km instead of 102,686 km gives ~27.8% of list at dealer asking, i.e. ~NT$1,035,000; private sale set ~14.0% below that asking price = NT$890,000, dealer trade-in a further ~18.5% below private. Cross-check: converting the real 13-year E89 point to a private-sale equivalent (23.9% x ~0.88 = ~21.0% of list) means this checkpoint sits only ~3.5pp above a car three years older with 47% more mileage — the tail is still declining, not flattening, which is the correct German shape. Trimmed below the raw 2.0L-derived ratio because the M40i is a 3.0L carrying NT$22,410/yr of TW road+fuel tax, which suppresses old-car demand, and heavier out-of-warranty repair fear than the four-cylinder comparator. Revised down from NT$940,000: at 25.9% of real_cost the researcher's figure matched a NT$2.69M 2.0L BMW 420i in this dataset, whereas the 3.0L/NT$4M-plus German cars in the same batch (7-Series 17.5%, Cayenne 18.8%) show that dearer, bigger-engined German cars fall further in percentage terms. Explicitly extrapolated, not observed.

maintenance.plan_notes: All figures are period costs SINCE THE PREVIOUS checkpoint, not cumulative. HONESTY FLAG: these are engineering estimates built from BMW Taiwan authorised-dealer parts and labour price levels (roughly NT$2,500-3,500/hr at 汎德/汎德永業 workshops), NOT copied from a retrieved price table — bmw.com.tw and Mobile01 both refused automated retrieval, so no official TW service-price page or owner receipt thread could be opened and quoted. Every checkpoint is therefore marked low confidence. INTERVAL LOGIC: at 7,000 km/year the owner never reaches BMW's Condition Based Service mileage triggers, so servicing is time-driven — one annual oil service (B58 inline-6, ~7L LL-01), brake fluid every 2 years, cabin/air filters on time, spark plugs on a ~4-year clock, and tires replaced because the rubber ages out (~5-6 years) rather than because the tread is gone. WARRANTY / PACKAGES: BMW Taiwan's standard new-car cover is a 3-year unlimited-mileage warranty, which absorbs repair (not servicing) cost in the first two periods — that is why years 0-1 and 1-3 are modest. Prepaid service packages (BMW Service Inclusive / 尊榮保養套餐) are sold in Taiwan, but the current 2026 package contents and price could not be verified, so NO subsidy is assumed: scheduled servicing is priced as owner-paid dealer work throughout. The 5-7 and 7-10 periods deliberately carry the FULL unsubsidised out-of-warranty cost including probability-weighted risk items. CORRECTED BY FACT-CHECK: (1) the 5-7 year period was raised from NT$148,000 to NT$168,000 because the researcher's figure was LOWER than the 3-5 year period, which breaks the requirement that period cost generally rises with age — the 5-7 window carries the ZF 8-speed transmission oil-and-filter service (~NT$28,000 at a TW BMW dealer) and front M Sport discs plus pads (~NT$45,000) on top of two oil services, coolant, diff oil and the soft-top service, which does not fit inside NT$148,000. (2) The researcher claimed this plan runs 'roughly two to three times a Japanese equivalent'; that overstates its own numbers. The right comparator is the Toyota GR Supra in this same dataset — same B58 engine, same ZF8 gearbox, same platform, same 2-seat body — whose 10-year total is NT$470,000. This plan now totals NT$729,000, i.e. ~1.55x, and the gap is real but comes from dealer labour rates, 19-inch staggered run-flats, larger M Sport brakes and the powered fabric roof rather than from the engine. The claim has been corrected rather than the numbers inflated to match it. COST LEVEL: ~NT$729,000 across ten years and only 70,000 km (~NT$73,000/year), driven by dealer labour rates, tires, brakes, known B58 items (electric water pump, thermostat housing, coil packs), the M Sport adaptive damper risk and the fabric roof mechanism. If the M40i does after all carry a 48V starter-generator (unverified — see purchase.notes), the 7-10 period would need an additional ISG/48V-battery allowance.

assumptions.notes:
Buyer drives 6,000-8,000 km/year, far below the Taiwan average of 12,000-15,000 km/year. All checkpoints use assumed_km = 7000 * years (7000/21000/35000/49000/70000). At this mileage every Mercedes service interval is TIME-driven, not distance-driven: ASSYST PLUS calls the car in at 1 year or 10,000 km whichever comes first, so the owner pays for a full service every year while covering only ~7,000 km. Consumables therefore age out rather than wear out — tires are replaced on rubber age (~every 5-6 years), brake fluid every 2 years, coolant on schedule. Low mileage is a genuine resale advantage in Taiwan and the used comps quoted here are low-mileage listings, not mileage-blind averages. Tax (牌照稅/燃料稅) and insurance are excluded from every figure by design. Fuel is also excluded. The A 180 carries a 48V mild-hybrid belt starter-generator; it cannot move the car on electricity alone, so it is classified gasoline, not hybrid.

PRICE-LADDER CORRECTION (fact-check pass): the W177 A 180's Taiwan list price has moved a great deal over the generation's life — launched at 1,600,000 (2018/2019), rose to roughly 1,770,000-1,810,000 by 2021, reached 1,840,000 as the 進化版, and was cut to 1,650,000 for the MY2026 摘星版. Per-model-year retention ratios therefore whipsaw and are misleading. Every used checkpoint below is instead built from the ABSOLUTE observed dealer-retail asking price at the matching age and mileage, then scaled by the ratio of this car's real_cost to that comp car's original list price. That scaling already embeds the effect of the 190,000 price cut, so no second 'price-cut haircut' is applied on top — doing so double-counts, which is one of the errors corrected in this pass.

The scout's and the researcher's figure of NT$1,650,000 is CORRECT and is used unchanged (0% deviation). The udn road-test headline also independently confirms the 摘星版 is the 掀背 (hatchback) body, validating the trim label. Discount and on-road fees are estimated from Taiwan Mercedes dealer practice, not from a published table.
purchase.notes:
48V MILD HYBRID — NOT A HYBRID FOR THIS TABLE. The facelifted W177 A 180 uses the M282 1.33L turbo four with a 48V EQ Boost belt-driven starter-generator (adds ~14 hp / 3 kgm). It cannot propel the car on battery alone, so powertrain is classified gasoline. Listings often label it 輕油電, which is misleading here. The 48V system matters for cost in the other direction: the RSG starter-generator, its 48V lithium pack and the DC/DC converter are expensive out-of-warranty failure items and are budgeted in the year 7-10 maintenance period.

PRICE CUT CONTEXT: for model year 2026 Mercedes-Benz Taiwan renamed A 180 進化版 to A 180 摘星版 and cut the list price by NT$190,000 (1,840,000 to 1,650,000). This was achieved partly by deleting equipment — multi-beam LED headlights, the panoramic sunroof and the air-purification system are gone — while adding a 12-speaker Burmester audio system. Verified directly against 8891 新車頻道 21805.

DISCOUNT NT$60,000: modest by German-brand standards precisely because of the official repricing. The A-Class is a slow seller in Taiwan (the market strongly prefers SUVs such as GLA/GLB), which sustains some negotiating room, but a dealer will not repeat a cut the factory just made. NT$60,000 is realistically achievable as cash-off plus accessory credit; a buyer pushing hard at quarter-end might reach NT$80,000-100,000. Retained from the researcher's record — reasonable and unchallenged.

ON-ROAD FEES NT$55,000 = 領牌 (plate registration) ~NT$5,000 + 代辦費 (paperwork agency) ~NT$7,000 + 配件 (window film, dashcam, ceramic coating, mats) ~NT$43,000. Accessory spend scales with car price and is higher on a German luxury car than on a mainstream Japanese one. TAX AND INSURANCE ARE EXCLUDED as instructed — no 牌照稅, no 燃料稅, no 強制險, no 任意險.

REAL COST = 1,650,000 - 60,000 + 55,000 = NT$1,645,000. Arithmetic verified.
